र: र The twenty-seventh consonant of the Nāgarī Alphabet, corresponding to the letter R.
र m. (रः) 1 Fire or Agni. 2 Heat, warmth. 3 Burning, scorching. 4 Love, desire. 5 Speed. f. (-रा) 1 Giving. 2 Gold. f. (री) Going, moving. E. रा to give, रम to play, &c., aff. ड.
रंहति: रंहति f. (-तिः) Speed, velocity, in general, or the speed of a chariot. E. रम to sport, क्तिन् aff., हुक् augment.
रंहस्: रंहस् n. (-हः) Speed, velocity. E. रम to sport, Uṇādi aff. असुन्, हुक् augment.
रक: रक r. 10th cl. (राकयति) 1 To taste. 2 To obtain.
रक m. (-कः) 1 The sun gem. 2 Crystal. 3 A hard shower. E. रक to obtain, अच् aff.
रक्त: रक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Dyed, tinged, coloured, stained. 2 Red, of a red colour. 3 Fond of, attached to, affected with love or interest towards any object. 4 Pure, purified. 5 Sporting, engaging in play or pastime. m. (-क्तः) Red, the colour. n. (-क्तं) 1 Blood. 2 Saffron. 3 Copper. 4 Minium. 5 Vermilion. 6 The fruit of the Flacourtia cataphracta. f. (-क्ता) 1 The Gunja plant, (Abrus precatorius.) 2 Lac. 3 Bengal madder. E. रञ्ज to colour or dye, &c., aff. क्त.
रक्तक: रक्तक m. (-कः) 1 A plant bearing a red blossom, (Pentapetes phoenicea; it is also applied to the Ixora bandhuca.) 2 Globe amaranth, (Gomphræna globosa, the red variety.) 3 Red garments or cloth. 4 A man affected with passion or fondness. 5 A gamboller, a player, one who plays or sports. 6 Safflower. E. कन् added to the preceding.
रक्तकन्द: रक्तकन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 Coral. 2 A sort of onion. 3 A kind of yam (Dioscorea purpurea?) E. रक्त red, and कन्द a root.
रक्तकन्दल: रक्तकन्दल m. (-लः) Coral. E. रक्त red, कन्द, and लच् aff.
रक्तकमल: रक्तकमल n. (-लं) The red lotus. E. रक्त red, and कमल the lotus.
रक्तकाञ्चन: रक्तकाञ्चन m. (-नः) Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata.) E. रक्त red, and काञ्चन the same.
रक्तकुमुद: रक्तकुमुद n. (-दं) The red lotus, (Nymphæa rubra, Rox.) E. रक्त red, and कुमुद the lotus.
रक्तकैरव: रक्तकैरव n. (-वं) The red lotus. E. रक्त, and कैरव a lotus.
रक्तकोकनद: रक्तकोकनद n. (-दं) The red lotus. E. रक्त, and कोकनद a lotus.
रक्तगुल्म: रक्तगुल्म m. (-ल्मः) 1 A disease, a hard lump in the abdomen of the female after conception, perhaps scirrhus of the ovarium. 2 A clot of blood. E. रक्त, and गुल्म cluster.
रक्तघ्न: रक्तघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A small tree, (Andersonia rohitaka.) f. (-घ्नी) A kind of grass, a variety of the Dūb grass. E. रक्त blood, and घ्न removing; anti-plethoric.
रक्तचन्दन: रक्तचन्दन n. (-नं) 1 Red wood, either red Sandal or sappan wood. 2 Saffron. E. रक्त red, and चन्दन Sandal.
रक्तचूर्ण: रक्तचूर्ण n. (-र्णं) 1 Red lead. 2 Any red powder. E. रक्त red, चूर्ण powder, dust.
रक्तजन्तुक: रक्तजन्तुक m. (-कः) An earthworm. E. रक्त red, and जन्तु an insect, aff. कन्.
रक्तजिह्व: रक्तजिह्व m. (-ह्वः) A lion. E. रक्त red, and जिह्वा the tongue.
रक्ततुण्ड: रक्ततुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A parrot. E. रक्त red, and तुण्ड a beak.
रक्तत्व: रक्तत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Redness. 2 Passion, affection. E. त्व added to रक्त; also with तल्, रक्तता.
रक्तदन्ती: रक्तदन्ती f. (-न्ती) A name of PĀRVATĪ. E. रक्त red, दन्त a tooth, aff. ङीष्.
रक्तदृश्: रक्तदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Red-eyed. m. (-दृक्) A pigeon. E. रक्त red, and दृश् the eye.
रक्तधातु: रक्तधातु m. (-तुः) 1 Red chalk or red orpiment. 2 Copper. E. रक्त red, and धातु a mineral.
रक्तनयन: रक्तनयन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Red-eyed. m. (-नः) The Greek partridge, (Perdix rufa.) E. रक्त red, and नयन the eye, red-eyed.
रक्तनासिक: रक्तनासिक m. (-कः) An owl. E. रक्त red, नासिका the nose.
रक्तप: रक्तप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Who or what drinks blood. m. (-पः) An imp, a goblin. f. (-पा) 1 A leech. 2 A female goblin. E. रक्त blood, and प what drinks, from पा with क aff. and टाप् for the feminine.
रक्तपक्ष: रक्तपक्ष m. (-क्षः) GARUḌA. E. रक्त red, and पक्ष wing.
रक्तपदी: रक्तपदी f. (-दी) A plant, variously considered as a sort of sensitive plant or a species of Lycopodium. E. रक्त red, पद foot or root, aff. ङीष्.
रक्तपात: रक्तपात m. (-तः) Spilling of blood. E. रक्त and पात causing to fall.
रक्तपाता: रक्तपाता f. (-ता) A leech. E. रक्त blood, and पात nourished.
रक्तपाद: रक्तपाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Red-footed. m. (-दः) A parrot. E. रक्त red, and पाद foot.
रक्तपायिन्: रक्तपायिन् m. (-यी) A bug. f. (-नी) A leech. E. रक्त blood, and पायिन् what drinks.
रक्तपारद: रक्तपारद n. (-दं) Native vermilion, cinnabar. E. रक्त red, and पारद quicksilver.
रक्तपिण्ड: रक्तपिण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 The China rose, (Hibiscus rosa sinensis.) 2 A climbing plant, (Ventilago madraspatana.) 3 A spontaneous discharge of blood from the nose and mouth. 4 A red pimple or boil. E. रक्त red, and पिण्ड lump.
रक्तपित्त: रक्तपित्त m. (-त्तः) Plethora, spontaneous hæmorrhages from the mouth, nose, rectum and cuticle, accompanied with fever and headache, vomiting, purging, &c. E. रक्त red, and पित्त bile, the bile being of that colour; or रक्त blood, and पित्त bile, it being supposed to be an affection of both fluids or humors.
रक्तपित्तहा: रक्तपित्तहा f. (-हा) Variety of bent grass, (Panicum dactylon.) E. रक्तपित्त the disease, and हा what removes.
रक्तपुष्प: रक्तपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 Nerium odorum, the red variety. 2 A small tree, (Andersonia rohitaca, Rox.) mf. (-ष्पः-ष्पा) The silk-cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.) f. (-ष्पी) 1 The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) 2 Bryony, (Bryonia grandis.) E. रक्त red, and पुष्प flower, whence it may be applied to any plant bearing red blossoms.
रक्तपुष्पक: रक्तपुष्पक m. (-कः) 1 The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.) 2 A small tree, (Andersonia rohitaca, Rox.) 3 A red flower, (Ixora bandhuca, or Pentapetes phoenicea.) 4 The silk-cotton tree. 5 The coral tree. 6 A tree from which a red dye is prepared, (Rottleria tinctorea.) f. (-ष्पिका) A sort of sensitive plant or species of Lycopodium. E. कन् added to the preceding.
रक्तफल: रक्तफल m. (-लः) The Indian fig tree. f. (-ला) A cucurbitaceous plant, (Momordica monadelpha.) E. रक्त red, and फल fruit.
रक्तफेनज: रक्तफेनज m. (-जः) A part of the body, apparently intending the lungs. E. रक्त blood, फेन froth or phlegm, and ज born.
रक्तबालुक: रक्तबालुक n. (-कं) Red lead. E. रक्त red, and बालुका sand.
रक्तमञ्जर: रक्तमञ्जर m. (-रः) A plant, (Barringtonia acutangula.) E. रक्त red, मञ्जरी a pedicle, aff. टच्.
रक्तमण्डल: रक्तमण्डल n. (-लं) The red lotus. E. रक्त red, and मण्डल a circle.
रक्तमय: रक्तमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Bloody, full or consisting of blood. E. रक्त, and मयट् aff.
रक्तमोक्षण: रक्तमोक्षण n. (-णं) Bleeding, letting blood. E. रक्त, and मोक्षण loosing.
रक्तयष्टि: रक्तयष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.) E. रक्त red, यष्टि a stick.
रक्तरेणु: रक्तरेणु m. (-णुः) 1 Red lead. 2 The blossom of the Palāśa, (Butea frondosa.) 3 A sort of cloth. 4 An angry man. E. रक्त red, and रेणु dust; also with कन् added in the second meaning रक्तरेणुका.
रक्तलोचन: रक्तलोचन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Red-eyed. m. (-नः) A pigeon. E. रक्त, and लोचन an eye.
रक्तवटी: रक्तवटी f. (-टी) Small pox. E. रक्त red, and वटी a pustule.
रक्तवरटी: रक्तवरटी f. (-टी) Small pox. E. रक्त red, वरटी a pustule.
रक्तवर्ण: रक्तवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Red, of a red colour. m. (-र्णः) 1 An earthworm. 2 Red, (the colour.) E. रक्त red, and वर्ण colour.
रक्तवर्द्धन: रक्तवर्द्धन m. (-नः) The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. रक्त blood, and वर्द्धन increasing.
रक्तवसन: रक्तवसन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Dressed in red. m. (-नः) The mendicant, or Brahman of the fourth order, especially as occasionally clad in red garments. E. रक्त red, and वसन vesture.
रक्तवाहिन्: रक्तवाहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Conveying blood, (as an artery.) E. रक्त, and वाहिन् what bears.
रक्तविद्रधि: रक्तविद्रधि m. (-धिः) A sore or ulcer from a vitiated state of blood. E. रक्त, and विद्रधि a sore.
रक्तविन्दु: रक्तविन्दु m. (-न्दुः) 1 A red spot forming a flaw in a gem. 2 A drop of blood. E. रक्त fed, and विन्दु a drop.
रक्तवीज: रक्तवीज m. (-जः) 1 The pomegranate. 2 The name of a demon killed by DURGĀ. E. रक्त red, and वीज the seed.
रक्तवृन्ता: रक्तवृन्ता f. (-न्ता) A flower, (Nyctanthes tristis.) E. रक्त red, and वृन्त a stalk.
रक्तशालि: रक्तशालि m. (-लिः) A red variety of rice, (Oriza sativa.) E. रक्त red, शालि rice.
रक्तशासन: रक्तशासन n. (-नं) Red lead. E. रक्त red, and साशन an edict; from the document perhaps being sealed or signed with a preparation of this substance.
रक्तश्राव: रक्तश्राव m. (-वः) 1 Venesection, bleeding. 2 A kind of dock or sorrel. E. रक्त, and श्राव causing to flow; also रक्तश्रावणं.
रक्तसंकोच: रक्तसंकोच n. (-चं) Safflower. E. रक्त red, (a dye,) सङ्कोच a contracting.
रक्तसङ्कोचक: रक्तसङ्कोचक n. (-कं) The blue lotus. E. कन् added to the last.
रक्तसंज्ञ: रक्तसंज्ञ n. (-ज्ञं) Saffron. E. रक्त red or blood, and संज्ञा appellation; also similar compounds, as रक्तनामन्, रक्तनामक, &c.
रक्तसन्ध्याक: रक्तसन्ध्याक n. (-कं) The red lotus, (Nymphæa rubra.). E. रक्त red, सन्ध्या twilight, कन् aff. of comparison.
रक्तसरोरुह: रक्तसरोरुह n. (-हं) The red lotus. E. रक्त, and सरोरुह a lotus.
रक्तसौगन्धिक: रक्तसौगन्धिक m. (-कं) A kind of dock or sorrel. E. रक्त blood, &c., and सौगन्धिक a lotus.
रक्तहंसा: रक्तहंसा f. (-सा) One of the Rāgiṇīs or female personifications of the musical modes.
रक्तहीन: रक्तहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Bloodless, cold-blooded. E. रक्त, and हीन devoid of.
रक्ताक्त: रक्ताक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Sprinkled with blood. 2 Dyed red. n. (-क्तं) Red wood, (Pterocarpus santolinus; applied also to the Cæsalpinia sappan.) E. रक्त, and आक्त sprinkled, spread
रक्ताक्ष: रक्ताक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Red-eyed. m. (-क्षः) 1 A buffalo. 2 A pigeon. 3 The Greek partridge, (Perdix rufa.) 4 A tyrant, a savage, a barbarous or cruel man. 5 The Indian crane. E. रक्त red, and अक्षि the eye, aff. ष.
रक्ताङ्ग: रक्ताङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The planet MARS. 2 A plant, (a species of Crinum.) 3 A bug. n. (-ङ्गं) 1 Coral. 2 Saffron. f. (-ङ्गी) A plant, (Celtis orientalis.) E. रक्त red, and अङ्ग body.
रक्तातीसार: रक्तातीसार m. (-रः) Dysentery. E. रक्त, and अतीसार diarrhoea.
रक्ताधार: रक्ताधार m. (-रः) The skin. E. रक्त blood, आघार receptacle.
रक्ताधिमन्थ: रक्ताधिमन्थ m. (-न्थः) Inflammation of the eyes, ophthalmia with sponginess of the vessels so as to discharge blood on being touched. E. रक्त, and अधिमन्थ ophthalmia.
रक्ताभिष्यन्द: रक्ताभिष्यन्द m. (-न्दः) Redness of the vessels of the eye with flow of tears. E. रक्त, and अभिष्यन्द flow.
रक्ताम्बर: रक्ताम्बर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Dressed in red. m. (-रः) Any vagrant devotee, wearing red garments. E. रक्त red, and अम्बर vesture.
रक्ताम्लान: रक्ताम्लान m. (-नः) Globe amaranth, the red variety. E. रक्त red, and अम्लान amaranth.
रक्तालु: रक्तालु m. (-लुः) A sort of yam, (Dioscorea purpurea.) E. रक्त red, and आलु yam.
रक्तावसेचन: रक्तावसेचन n. (-नं) Letting blood, bleeding. E. रक्त, and अवसेचन sprinkling.
रक्ताशय: रक्ताशय m. (-यः) Viscus in which the blood is contained or secreted, viz. the heart, the liver, and the spleen. E. रक्त, and आशय receptacle.
रक्ति: रक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Affection, attachment. 2 Addiction to. E. रञ्ज to be affected, aff. क्तिन्.
रक्तिका: रक्तिका f. (-का) 1 A plant, (Abrus precatorius). 2 The seed of the Abrus precatorius used as a weight, or a fictitious weight, denominated from the seeds originally so used; the seed weighs about 1 and (5/16) troy grain, the artificial ratti or Raktikā should be double that weight, but in common use it averages nearly 2 grains and a quarter. E. रक्त red, कन् aff., fem. form.
रक्तेक्षण: रक्तेक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Red-eyed, having the eyes inflamed or blood-shot. E. रक्त, and ईक्षण the eye.
रक्तोत्पल: रक्तोत्पल n. (-लं) The red lotus, (Nymphæa rubra.) E. रक्त red, उत्पल lotus.
रक्तोत्पलाभ: रक्तोत्पलाभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Red. m. (-भः) Redness, red, the colour. E. रक्तोत्पल the red lotus, आभ resembling.
रक्तोपल: रक्तोपल n. (-लं) Indurated ochre, or clay iron stone. E. रक्त red, उपला a stone, hence applied also to red ochre, red orpiment, red chalk, &c.
रक्ष: रक्ष r. 1st cl. (रक्षति) To guard, to protect, to cherish, to preserve. With परि, To save from ruin.

रक्ष mf. (-क्षः-क्षा) 1 Preserving, protecting. 2 Lac. f. (-क्षा) 1 Ashes. 2 A sort of bracelet, a twist of thread or tinsel, with a small packet containing a few carminative seeds, bound round the wrist at particular periods, especially the day of full moon in Śrāvaṇa. E. रक्ष to preserve, aff. अच्.
रक्षःसभ: रक्षःसभ n. (-भं) A multitude or assemblage of goblins. E. रक्षस् a demon, and सभा assemblage.
रक्षक: रक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what protects, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A guardian, a protector. 2 A watch, a guard. E. रक्ष to preserve, वुन् aff.
रक्षण: रक्षण n. (-णं) Preserving, protecting, defending. E. रक्ष to preserve, aff. ल्युट्.
रक्षणीय: रक्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be guarded, preserved, protected, &c. E. रक्ष to preserve, अनीयर् aff.
रक्षणीरक: रक्षणीरक m. (-कः) Urinary affection, as gonorrhoea, &c. elsewhere read रक्षणारक.
रक्षत्: रक्षत् mfn. (-क्षन्-क्षन्ती-क्षत्) Preserving, guarding, protecting. E. रक्ष to preserve, शतृ aff.
रक्षस्: रक्षस् n. (-क्षः) A Rakṣas, an evil spirit, apparently distinguishable into three classes: one sort of Rakṣas is of a demi-celestial nature, and is ranked with the attendants on KUVERA; another corresponds to a goblin, an imp, or ogre, haunting cemeteries, animating dead bodies, disturbing sacrifices, and ensnaring and devouring human beings; the third kind approaches more to the nature of the Titan, or relentless and powerful enemy of the gods. E. रक्ष to preserve, (KUVERA'S treasures, &c.) असुन् aff.; also राक्षम.
रक्षस्पाश: रक्षस्पाश m. (-शः) A contemptible Rakṣas E. रक्षस्, and पाश aff.
रक्षाधिकृत: रक्षाधिकृत m. (-तः) A governor, a magistrate. E. रक्षा, and अधिकृत set over.
रक्षापेक्षक: रक्षापेक्षक m. (-कः) 1 A door-keeper or porter. 2 A guard of the women's apartments. 3 A catamite. 4 An actor, a mime. E. रक्ष preserving, अप before ईक्ष to see, aff. वुन्.
रक्षित: रक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Preserved, protected, defended. 2 Kept, detained. E. रक्ष to preserve, aff. क्त.
रक्षितव्य: रक्षितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be guarded, protected, &c. E. रक्ष to preserve, तव्य aff.
रक्षितृ: रक्षितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what protects, defends, &c., a protector, a guard. E. रक्ष to preserve, तृच् aff.
रक्षिन्: रक्षिन् mfn. (-क्षी-क्षिणी-क्षि) Who or what preserves or protects. E. रक्ष to preserve, घिनुण् aff.
रक्षिवर्ग: रक्षिवर्ग m. (-र्गः) A guard, a sentinel. E. रक्षि from रक्षिन् a preserver, and वर्ग class.
रक्षोगण: रक्षोगण m. (-णः) A class or troop of evil spirits. E. रक्षस्, and गण a troop.
रक्षोघ्न: रक्षोघ्न m. (-घ्नः) Marking-nut plant. n. (-घ्नं) 1 Sour gruel made from the fermentation of rice water. 2 Asafoetida. E. रक्षम् a goblin, and घ्न destroying, repelling.
रक्षोजननी: रक्षोजननी f. (-नी) Night. E. रक्षम् a sprite, and जननी mother.
रक्ष्ण: रक्ष्ण m. (-क्ष्णः) Preserving, guarding, defence, protection. E. रक्ष to preserve, aff. नङ्.
रक्ष्य: रक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) To be guarded, protected, preserved, &c. E. रक्ष to preserve, यत् aff.
रक्ष्यमाण: रक्ष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Preserved. E. रक्ष to preserve, pass. v., शानच् aff.
रख: रख r. 1st cl. (रखति) also (इ) रखि r. 1st cl. (रंखति) To go, to move.
रग: रग r. 1st cl. (ए) रगे) (रगति) To suspect, to doubt, to fear. r. 10th cl. (रागयति) 1 To taste. 2 To obtain. (इ) रगि r. 1st cl. (रंगति) To go, to move.
रघ: रघ(इ)रघि r. 1st cl. (रंघते) To go, to move. r. 10th cl. (रंघयति) To shine; also without the indicatory letter, r. 10th cl. (राघयति) To taste.
रघु: रघु m. (-घुः) 1 The name of a sovereign of Oude, the great grandfather of RĀMACANDRA. 2 The family or descendants of RAGHU. E. लघि to shine, कु Uṇādi aff., ल changed to र, and the nasal augment rejected.
रघुकार: रघुकार m. (-रः) The poet KĀLIDĀSA. E. रघु the race of RAGHU, which forms the subject of a poem by this writer, and कार author.
रघुनन्दन: रघुनन्दन m. (-नः) RĀMA, the second incarnation of VIṢṆU, under that appellation. E. रघु the king RAGHU, and नन्दन a son or descendant.
रघुनाथ: रघुनाथ m. (-थः) A name of RĀMA. E. रघु the race of RAGHU, and नाथ lord, chief.
रघुवंश: रघुवंश m. (-शः) The race or family of RAGHU; hence also the name of a poem by KĀLIDĀSA, which treats of the ancestors of RĀMA, from DILĪPA to that prince, and his descendants to AGNIVARṆA; nearly one half relates to the history of RAGHU and as much to that of RĀMA, the remainder is occupied with the remaining princes. E. रघु as above, and वंश race.
रघुवर: रघुवर m. (-रः) RĀMA. E. रघु the race of RAGHU, and वर eminent.
रघूद्वह: रघूद्वह m. (-हः) RĀMA. E. रघु the race of RAGHU, and उद्वह pre-eminent.
रङ्क: रङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) 1 Niggardly, avaricious, a miser. 2 Slow, dull. E. रकि to go, aff. अच्.
रङ्कु: रङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) A sort of deer, (the spotted axis.) E. रम to sport, aff. कु, form irr.
रङ्ग: रङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Paint, colour, tint, dye. 2 Dancing, acting, singing, &c. 3 A field of battle. 4 The place where acting, &c. is exhibited, a stage. 5 A place answering to an amphitheatre. n. (-ङ्गं) Tin. E. रगि to go, aff. अच्, or रञ्ज to colour, aff. घञ्, the final changed and the nasal rejected.
रङ्गज: रङ्गज n. (-जं) Red lead. E. रङ्ग colour, ज produced.
रङ्गजीवक: रङ्गजीवक m. (-कः) 1 An actor, a dancer, a mime. 2 A painter. E. रङ्ग a stage or colour, &c., and जीवक who lives by.
रङ्गभूति: रङ्गभूति m. (-तिः) The day of full moon in the month Aśvin, (September-October,) on the night of which LAKṢMĪ descended, promising wealth to all who were awake. E. रङ्ग dancing and singing, and भूति being, the night being spent in playing ancient chess, in Nāces, &c.
रङ्गभूमि: रङ्गभूमि f. (-मिः) 1 A field of battle. 2 A stage, a theatre, a place where dancing is exhibited, or the Indian dramas were represented. E. रङ्ग dancing, &c., and भूमि ground, spot.
रङ्गमल्ली: रङ्गमल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A lute. E. रङ्ग singing, &c., मल्ल to hold, affs. अच् and ङीष्.
रङ्गमातृ: रङ्गमातृ f. (-ता) 1 A bawd. 2 Lac, the animal dye. E. रङ्ग passion or colour, &c., and मातृ parent.
रङ्गमातृका: रङ्गमातृका f. (-का) Lac, or the insect which forms the red dye so called. E. रङ्ग colour, and मातृ parent, कन् added.
रङ्गलासिनी: रङ्गलासिनी f. (-नी) A flower, (Nyctanthes tristis.) E. रङ्ग colour, (of the stalk,) लस to shine, aff. णिनि.
रङ्गवीज: रङ्गवीज n. (-जः) Silver. E. रङ्ग tin, वीज seed or essence.
रङ्गशाला: रङ्गशाला f. (-ला) A hall for public exhibitions, as Nāces, plays, &c., a ball-room, a theatre. E. रङ्ग acting, &c., and शाला a hall.
रङ्गाजीव: रङ्गाजीव m. (-वः) 1 A painter. 2 An actor, a dancer. E. रङ्ग colour, &c., and जाजीव who lives by.
रङ्गावतरण: रङ्गावतरण n. (-णं) Acting, playing, exhibiting in public. E. रङ्ग, and अवतरण alighting.
रङ्गावतारक: रङ्गावतारक m. (-कः) 1 An actor, a buffoon. 2 A boxer. 3 A bard or panegyrist. E. रङ्ग acting, dancing, अव depreciative prefix, तॄ to pass, वुन् aff.; also with णिनि aff., रङ्गावतारिन्.
रङ्गिन्: रङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिणी-ङ्गि) 1 Colouring, dying. 2 Impassioned, having propensity or passion. f. (-णी) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus). E. रङ्ग colour, &c., इनि aff.
रङ्घस्: रङ्घस् n. (-ङ्घः) Speed, velocity: see रंहस; ह being changed to घ.
रच: रच r. 10th cl. (रचयति) 1 To make mechanically, to work, to manufacture. 2 To write, to compose, to make as a book.
रचक: रचक n. (-कः) A maker, a composer. E. रच to make, वुन् aff.
रचना: रचना f. (-ना) 1 Orderly and becoming arrangement or disposition in general. 2 Decoration or dressing of the hair. 3 Stringing flowers, &c., weaving wreaths, chaplets, or similar decorations. 4 Military array, the arrangement of troops. 5 Literary composition, whether in verse or prose. 6 Suspending garlands, &c. at the doors of a house or building on festival occasions. 7 Making or preparing any thing. E. रच to make, to manufacture, aff. युच्.
रचित: रचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made, manufactured. 2 Written, composed. 3 Strung. E. रच to make, aff. क्त.
रज: रज mn. (-जः-जं) 1 Dust. 2 The pollen of flowers. 3 The menstrual excretion. 4 The second property of humanity, the quality of passion. E. रञ्ज to colour, &c., aff. अच्, and the nasal rejected; this word more commonly occurs रजस्, q. v.
रजःशय: रजःशय m. (-यः) A dog. E. रजम् dust, and शय who sleeps.
रजःसारथि: रजःसारथि m. (-थिः) Air, wind. E. रजस् dust, and सारथि charioteer.
रजक: रजक m. (-कः) 1 A washerman. 2 Cloth, clothes. f. (-की) A washerman's wife or a washerwoman. E. रञ्ज to colour, (clothes,) ष्वुन् or क्वुन् aff.; in the latter case the fem. is रजिका a washerwoman, and रजकी a washerman's wife.
रजत: रजत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) White. n. (-तं) 1 A necklace. 2 Silver. 3 Gold. 4 Elephant's teeth, ivory. 5 The name of a lake. 6 The name of a mountain, perhaps Kailāsa: see रजताद्रि. 7 White, (the colour.) 8 Blood. 9 An asterism, a constellation. E. रञ्ज to colour, &c., अतच् Uṇādi aff.
रजतद्युति: रजतद्युति m. (-तिः) The monkey HANUMĀN. E. रजत silver, and द्युति lustre.
रजतप्रस्थ: रजतप्रस्थ m. (-स्थः) Mount Kailāsa, the residence of KUVERA and his attendant demigods. E. रजत white, (or silver,) and प्रस्थ table land.
रजताद्रि: रजताद्रि m. (-द्रिः) Mount Kailāsa: see the last. E. रजत silver, and अद्रि mountain.
रजन: रजन n. (-नं) Colouring, dyeing, painting. E. रञ्ज to colour, Uṇādi aff. युच्.
रजनि: रजनि f. (-निः-नी) 1 Night. 2 The indigo plant. 3 Turmerick. 4 Lac. E. रञ्ज to colour, अनि Uṇādi aff., and ङीष् optionally added.
रजनिकर: रजनिकर m. (-रः) The moon. E. रजनि, and कर who makes; also रजनीकर.
रजनिचर: रजनिचर m. (-रः) 1 A goblin. 2 A thief. E. रजनि, and चर who goes; also रजनीचर.
रजनीकर: रजनीकर m. (-रः) The moon. E. रजनी night, and कर who makes.
रजनीगन्ध: रजनीगन्ध m. (-न्धः) The tuberose, (Polianthes tuberosa.) E. रजनी night, and गन्ध smell, emitting a powerful smell after sun-set.
रजनीचर: रजनीचर m. (-रः) 1 A Rākṣasa, a fiend, a goblin, a ghost. 2 A watchman. 3 A thief. E. रजनी night, and चर who goes.
रजनीजल: रजनीजल n. (-लं) Frost, hoar frost, dew. E. रजनी night, and जल water, falling at night.
रजनीमुख: रजनीमुख n. (-खं) Evening, beginning of the night. E. रजनी night, and मुख commencement.
रजनीहासा: रजनीहासा f. (-सा) A flower, (Nyctanthes arbor tristis.) E. रजनी night, and हास a smile; the flowers blossoming at night, and diffusing a powerful scent after sun-set.
रजस्: रजस् n. (-जः) 1 The second condition of humanity, the quality or property of passion; that which produces sensual desire, worldly coveting, pride, and falsehood, and is the cause of pain. 2 Dust. 3 The dust or pollen of a flower. 4 The menstrual evacuation. E. रञ्ज to colour, to be attached to, Uṇādi aff. असुन्.
रजसानु: रजसानु m. (-नुः) 1 A cloud. 2 The heart or mind. E. रञ्ज to colour, to feel affection for, and सानु Uṇādi aff.
रजस्वल: रजस्वल m. (-लः) A buffalo. f. (-ला) A woman during menstruation. E. रजस् dust, &c., and वलच् aff.
रजित: रजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Affected, moved, attracted, or excited by. E. रञ्ज to affect, causal v., and क्त aff.
रजोबन्ध: रजोबन्ध m. (-न्धः) Suppression of menstruation. E. रजस्, and बन्ध binding.
रजोबल: रजोबल n. (-लं) Darkness. E. रजस् dust, बल heap.
रजोरस: रजोरस m. (-सं) Darkness. E. रजस् dust, and रस essence, or perhaps this and the preceding should be the same.
रजोहर: रजोहर m. (-रः) A washerman. E. रजस् dust, dirt, and हर who removes.
रज्जु: रज्जु m. (-ज्जुः) 1 A rope, a cord, a tie, a string. 2 A lock of braided hair. E. सृज to create, &c. Uṇādi aff. उ, and the radical स rejected, and the vowel changed to its semivowel.
रञ्ज: रञ्ज (औ) r. 1st cl. औरञ्ज (रजति-ते) 4th cl. (रज्यति-ते) To dye, to tinge, to give tint or colour to any thing. r. 1st cl. (रजति) To be attached to or intent on, to have one's affections or passions engaged by any object. With अनु prefixed, To be fond of or attached to. With अप and वि, To be averse, to dislike.
रञ्जक: रञ्जक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 What incites or affects. 2 What colours, &c. m. (-कः) 1 Colouring, dyeing. 2 A colorist, a painter. 3 A dyer. 4 A stimulus, an inciter of affection, &c. 5 Biliary humour on which vision depends. E. रञ्ज to colour, वुन aff.
रञ्जन: रञ्जन mn. (-नः-नं) 1 Colouring, dyeing, painting, &c. 2 Affecting the heart, exciting passion, &c. n. (-नं) Red Sandal or Sappan wood. f. (-नी) 1 The indigo plant, (Indigofera tinctoria.) 2 Bengal madder. 3 Another plant, commonly Śuṇḍārocanī, (a species of Crinum?) 4 A flower, (Nyctanthes tristis.) E. रञ्ज to colour, aff. युच्.
रञ्जित: रञ्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Moved or affected. 2 Coloured, dyed, tinted. E. रञ्ज to colour, क्त aff.
रट: रट r. 1st and 10th cls. (रटति रटयति) To speak.
रटत्: रटत् mfn. (-टन्-टन्ती-टत्) Speaking. E. रट to speak, शतृ aff.
रटन: रटन n. (-नं) Speaking. E. रट, and ल्युट् aff.
रटन्ती: रटन्ती f. (-न्ती) The fourteenth of the dark half of Māgha, when bathing is enjoined. E. रट to speak, झच्. aff., the waters speak.
रटित: रटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spoken, said. n. (-तं) The roaring of flame. E. रट to speak, aff. क्त.
रण: रण r. 1st cl. (रणति) 1 To sound. 2 To go, to move.
रण mn. (-णः-णं) War, battle. m. (-णः) 1 Sound, noise. 2 The quill or bow of a lute, &c. 3 Going, moving. E. रण to sound, aff. अप्.
रणकामिन्: रणकामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Desirous of war, wishing to fight E. रण, and कामिन् who wishes.
रणत्: रणत् mfn. (-णन्-णन्ती-णत्) 1 Warring, fighting. 2 Going. 3 Sounding. E. रण to go, शतृ aff.
रणतूर्य: रणतूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A military drum. E. रण war, and तूर्य्य a musical instrument.
रणतूर्य्य: रणतूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A military drum. E. रण war, and तूर्य्य a musical instrument.
रणपण्डित: रणपण्डित m. (-तः) A warrior. E. रण, and पण्डित learned.
रणप्रिय: रणप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Warlike. n. (-यं) The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.) E. रण, and प्रिय fond of.
रणमत्त: रणमत्त m. (-त्तः) An elephant. E. रण war, and मत्त mad, wild.
रणरङ्क: रणरङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The part of an elephant's face between his tusks. E. रण war, and रङ्क slow.
रणरण: रणरण n. (-णं) Regret, anxiety, anxious regret, sorrow, of which the object is lost or absent. m. (-णः) A musquito, a gnat. E. रण war, and noise, repeated.
रणरणक: रणरणक m. (-कः) 1 Anxiety, regret: see the last. 2 Love, desire. E. रण to sound, repeated, aff. कन्.
रणसङ्कुल: रणसङ्कुल n. (-लं) Mixed or tumultuary combat. E. रण war, संकुल a mingling.
रणस्तम्भ: रणस्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 A trophy, a pillar. 2 A country, Chitore. E. रण, and स्तम्भ a pillar.
रणाङ्गण: रणाङ्गण n. (-णं) A field of battle. E. रण, and अङ्गण a court-yard.
रणाजिर: रणाजिर n. (-रं) A field of battle. E. रण, and अजिर a court.
रणाभियोग: रणाभियोग m. (-गः) Engaging in battle. E. रण, and अभियोग encounter.
रणित: रणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sounded, made as a noise. 2 Warred. E. रण to sound, क्त aff.
रणोत्साह: रणोत्साह m. (-हः) Prowess. E. रण, and उत्साह effort.
रण्डक: रण्डक m. (-कः) A barren tree. E. रण्डा a widow, aff. कन्.
रण्डा: रण्डा f. (-ण्डा) 1 A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.) 2 A widow. E. रम to sport, ड Uṇādi aff.
रत: रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Occupied or engaged by, actively intent on. n. (-तं) 1 Coition, copulation. 2 A privity, a private part. E. रम to sport, क्त aff.
रतकील: रतकील m. (-लः) A dog. E. रत copulation, and कील a pin, a fastening.
रतकूजित: रतकूजित n. (-तं) Lascivious murmur. E. रत copulation, and कूजित murmur.
रतगुरु: रतगुरु m. (-रुः) A husband. E. रत copulation, and गुरु teacher.
रतज्वर: रतज्वर m. (-रः) A crow. E. रत coition, ज्वर fever.
रततालिन्: रततालिन् m. (-ली) A libertine, a lecher, a whoremonger. E. रत copulation, तल to complete, aff. णिनि.
रतताली: रतताली f. (-ली) A bawd, a procuress. E. रत copulation, तल to complete or effect, and अण् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्.
रतनारीच: रतनारीच m. (-चः) 1 A dog. 2 KĀMA or love. 3 Sonitus in coitu. 4 A libertine, a lecher. E. रत coition, नारी a female, चि to collect, or चर to go, aff. क or ड.
रतनिधि: रतनिधि m. (-धिः) A wagtail. E. रत copulation, निधि a treasure.
रतर्द्धिक: रतर्द्धिक n. (-कं) 1 A day. 2 Bathing for pleasure. 3 The aggregate of four auspicious objects, &c. E. रत copulation, ऋधि increase, aff. कन्.
रतव्रण: रतव्रण m. (-णः) A dog. E. रत copulation, and व्रण a sore.
रतशायिन्: रतशायिन् m. (-यी) A dog. E. रत copulation, and शायिन् who sleeps.
रतहिण्डक: रतहिण्डक m. (-कः) 1 A libertine, a lecher. 2 A ravisher, one who carries off and violates a woman. E. रत coition, हिडि to go, aff. वुन्.
रतान्दुक: रतान्दुक m. (-कः) A dog. E. रत copulation, and अन्दुक a chain.
रतामर्द्ध: रतामर्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) A dog. E. रत coition, आङ् before मृध to rub, aff. अच्.
रतायनी: रतायनी f. (-नी) A whore, a harlot. E. रत copulation, अयन a going.
रतार्थिन्: रतार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Libidinous, lascivious. f. (-नी) A libidinous woman, a wanton harlot. E. रत copulation, अथ seeking, soliciting, इनि and ङीष् affs.
रति: रति f. (-तिः) 1 Passion, desire. 2 Coition, copulation. 3 A privity, a private part. 4 The wife of KĀMADEVA. E. रम to sport, aff. क्तिन्.
रतिकुहर: रतिकुहर n. (-रः) Pudendum muliebre. E. रति copulation, and कुहर a cavity.
रतिक्रिया: रतिक्रिया f. (-या) Copulation. E. रति the same, and क्रिया act.
रतिगृह: रतिगृह n. (-हं) The vagina. E. रति, and गृह abode, place.
रतिपति: रतिपति m. (-तिः) The deity of love, KĀMADEVA. E. रति the wife of the god, and पति husband.
रतिप्रिय: रतिप्रिय m. (-यः) KĀMADEVA. E. रति the wife of the deity, and प्रिय beloved.
रतिमदा: रतिमदा f. (-दा) A courtezan of INDRA'S heaven. E. रति copulation, मद to delight, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
रतिमन्दिर: रतिमन्दिर n. (-रं) Pudendum muliebre. E. रति copulation, and मन्दिर abode.
रतिरमण: रतिरमण m. (-णः) KĀMADEVA, the god of love. E. रति the goddess so named, and रसण husband.
रतिसत्वरा: रतिसत्वरा f. (-रा) A plant, (Trigonella corniculata.) E. रति copulation, सत्वर quick; perhaps considered as an aphrodisiac.
रतू: रतू f. (-तूः) 1 The Ganges of heaven. 2 An honest woman, one who speaks the truth. E. ऋत a Sautra root, कू Uṇādi aff., and अम् augment.
रतोद्वह: रतोद्वह m. (-हः) The Koil or Indian cuckoo. E. रत copulation, उद्वह exciting.
रत्न: रत्न n. (-त्नं) 1 A jewel, a gem. 2 Any thing the best of its kind, or figuratively, the jewel of the species. E. रम to sport, Uṇādi aff. न, and त substituted for the radical final.
रत्नकन्दल: रत्नकन्दल m. (-लः) Coral. E. रत्न a jewel, and कन्दल a shoot.
रत्नकूट: रत्नकूट m. (-टः) A mountain in the Dekshin. E. रत्न a jewel, and कूट a peak.
रत्नगर्भ: रत्नगर्भ m. (-र्भः) 1 The god of wealth, KUVERA. 2 The ocean. f. (-र्भा) The earth. E. रत्न a jewel, and गर्भ embryo.
रत्नप्रभा: रत्नप्रभा f. (-भा) The first of the seven hells or purgatories, according to the Jainas. E. रत्न a jewel, and प्रभा splendour.
रत्नमय: रत्नमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Gemmed, full or made of gems. E. रत्न, and मयट् aff.
रत्नमुख्य: रत्नमुख्य n. (-ख्यं) The diamond. E. रत्न a jewel, and मुख्य chief.
रत्नवत्: रत्नवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having gems. f. (-ती) The earth. E. रत्न a jewel, and मतुप् poss. aff.
रत्नवर्षुक: रत्नवर्षुक n. (-कं) The carriage of KUVERA. E. रत्न a jewel, and वर्षुक showering.
रत्नवृक्ष: रत्नवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) Coral. E. रत्न a jewel, and वृक्ष a tree.
रत्नसानु: रत्नसानु m. (-नुः) The mountain Meru. E. रत्न a jewel, and सानु ridge of a mountain.
रत्नसू: रत्नसू f. (-सूः) The earth. E. रत्न a jewel, and सू a mother.
रत्नाकर: रत्नाकर m. (-रः) 1 The ocean. 2 A jewel mine. E. रत्न a jewel, and आकर a mine.
रत्नाङ्क: रत्नाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The car of VIṢṆU. E. रत्न a jewel, and अङ्क mark.
रत्नावलि: रत्नावलि f. (-लिः) A necklace of gems. E. रत्न, and आवलि a row; also रत्नावली.
रत्नि: रत्नि mf. (-त्निः-त्नी) 1 A sort of cubit, measured from the elbow to the end of the closed fist; it is also computed at twenty-one breadths of the middle of the thumb. 2 The closed hand, the fist. E. ऋ to go, कत्निच् aff., the vowel changed to the semivowel, otherwise अरत्नि, and as derived from सृ to go, सरत्नि.
रत्यङ्ग: रत्यङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The male or female organ. E. रति copulation, अङ्ग member.
रथ: रथ m. (-थः) 1 A car, a war-chariot. 2 A car, a carriage in general, any vehicle or mode of conveyance. 3 A limb, a member. 4 The body. 5 A foot. 6. A sort of cane, (Calamus rotang.) E. रम to sport, Uṇādi aff. क्थन्.
रथकट्या: रथकट्या f. (-ट्या) A multitude of cars. E. रथ a car, and कट्यच् aff. of multitude.
रथकर: रथकर m. (-रः) A carpenter. E. रथ a car, and कर who makes; also रथकार and रथकृत्.
रथकार: रथकार m. (-रः) 1 A carpenter. 2 A man sprung from the male of the Māhiṣya, and woman of the Keren or writer caste; by profession, a maker of cars, a coach-maker. E. रथ a car, and कार who makes.
रथकुटुम्बिन्: रथकुटुम्बिन् m. (-म्बी) A charioteer. E. रथ a car, and कुटुम्बिन who takes care of as a part of his family.
रथगर्भक: रथगर्भक m. (-कः) A car or litter borne on men's shoulders. E. रथ a car, गर्भ an embryo, and कन् aff.
रथगुप्ति: रथगुप्ति f. (-प्तिः) A piece of wood, or an iron net-work, encompassing a war-chariot, to secure it from being injured by weapons or collision. E. रथ car, and गुप्ति screening, preserving; also रथगोपन n. (-नं).
रथचरण: रथचरण m. (-णः) The ruddy goose. E. रथ a car, and चरण the foot.
रथद्रु: रथद्रु m. (-द्रुः) A timber tree, (Dalbergia ougeiniensis.) E. रथ a car, and द्रु the tree, the wood being used for wheels, &c.; also रथद्रुम m. (-मः).
रथन्तर: रथन्तर n. (-रं) The Sāma Veda. E. रथ (as by) a car, तॄ to pass (the world), खच् aff.
रथपर्याय: रथपर्य्याय m. (-यः) A sort of cane, the ratan. E. रथ a car, and पर्य्याय order.
रथपर्य्याय: रथपर्य्याय m. (-यः) A sort of cane, the ratan. E. रथ a car, and पर्य्याय order.
रथपाद: रथपाद m. (-दः) 1 A wheel. 2 The ruddy goose. E. रथ a car, and पाद the foot.
रथप्सा: रथप्सा f. (-प्सा) The name of a river.
रथयात्रा: रथयात्रा f. (-त्रा) A festival at which the chariots of the gods go in procession: in Bengal and Orissa it is applied to the procession of the car of KṚṢṆA, as JAGANNĀTHA, on the second of the light fortnight of Āṣārha. E. रथ, and यात्रा going.
रथवाहक: रथवाहक m. (-कः) A charioteer. E. रथ, and वाहक what conveys.
रथाङ्ग: रथाङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 1 A wheel. 2 Any part of a carriage. m. (-ङ्गः) The ruddy goose, (Anas casarca.) E. रथ a car, अङ्ग a member.
रथाङ्गपाणि: रथाङ्गपाणि m. (-णिः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. रथाङ्ग a wheel, (the discus with which one of his, hands is armed,) and पाणि the hand; also रथाङ्गिन् and the like.
रथाभ्र: रथाभ्र m. (-भ्रः) A sort of cane, (Calamus rotang.) E. रथ the same, and अभ्र a cloud or water.
रथाभ्रपुष्प: रथाभ्रपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A sort of reed: see the last. E. रथाभ्र the same, and पुष्प a flower; also रथ, रथाभ्र, and अभ्रपुष्प.
रथारूढ: रथारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Mounted on or riding in a car. E. रथ, and आरूढ mounted.
रथारोहण: रथारोहण n. (-णं) 1 Riding in a car. 2 Fighting in a warchariot. E. रथ, and आरोहण mounting.
रथारोहिन्: रथारोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Riding in a car. m. (-ही) A warrior who fights in a car. E. रथ a car, and आरोहिन् who mounts.
रथार्भक: रथार्भक m. (-कः) A small car. E. रथ, and अर्भक small.
रथावरोहण: रथावरोहण n. (-णं) Alighting from a car. E. रथ, and अवरोहण descending.
रथावरोहिन्: रथावरोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Descending from a car. E. रथ, and अवरोहिन् who descends.
रथिक: रथिक m. (-कः) The owner of a car, or one who rides in it. E. रथ, and ष्ठन् aff.
रथिन्: रथिन् m. (-थी) 1 A warrior who fights in a car. 2 The owner of or rider in a car. E. रथ, and इनि aff.
रथिन: रथिन m. (-नः) The master of a car. E. रथ, and इन a master.
रथिर: रथिर m. (-रः) The owner of or rider in a car. E. रथ, and इरच् aff.
रथोपस्थ: रथोपस्थ m. (-स्थः) The charioteer's seat for driving. E. रथ, उप near, and स्थ what stays.
रथ्य: रथ्य m. (-थ्यः) A car or carriage horse. f. (-थ्यं) 1 A multitude of cars. 2 A high street. 3 A main or carriage road. 4 A place where several roads meet. n. (-थ्यं) A wheel. E. रथ a car, and य or यत् affixes of multitude or fitness.
रद: रद r. 1st cl. (रदति) 1 To divide, to split, to tear or break. 2 To dig, to delve, to root.
रद m. (-दः) 1 A tooth. 2 Splitting, tearing, dividing. E. रद to divide, &c., aff. अच्.
रदच्छद: रदछद m. (-दः) A lip. E. रद a tooth, and छद covering.
रदछद: रदछद m. (-दः) A lip. E. रद a tooth, and छद covering.
रदन: रदन m. (-नः) A tooth. n. (-नं) Tearing, rending. E. रद to divide, aff. ल्युट्.
रदनच्छद: रदनछद m. (-दः) A lip. E. रदन a tooth, and छद covering.
रदनछद: रदनछद m. (-दः) A lip. E. रदन a tooth, and छद covering.
रदिन्: रदिन् m. (-दी) An elephant. E. रद a tooth, a tusk, and इनि aff.
रद्ध: रद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Hurt, injured. E. रध to hurt, क्त aff.
रद्धृ: रद्धृ mfn. (-द्धा-द्धी-द्धृ) Injurious, hurtful, who or what hurts. E. रध to hurt, तृच् aff.
रध: रध(ऌ उ) ऌरधु r. 1st cl. (राध्यति) 1 To finish, to complete, to accomplish. 2 To hurt, to injure or kill. 3 To be right or correct. 4 To cook or mature.
रधित: रधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hurt, injured. E. रध to hurt, क्त aff.
रधितृ: रधितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Injurious, hurtful. E. रध to hurt, तृच् aff.
रन्ति: रन्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 Pleasure, sport. 2 Cessation, stop. E. रम to sport, क्तिच् aff.
रन्तिदेव: रन्तिदेव m. (-वः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 A king of the lunar dynasty; also called ŚAŚIDEVA. 3 A dog. E. रम, and देव a deity, or who sports or plays.
रन्तु: रन्तु f. (-न्तुः) 1 A road. 2 A river. E. रम to sport, &c., aff. तु.
रन्धक: रन्धक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Injurious, hurtful. E. रध to hurt, ण्वुल् aff.
रन्ध्र: रन्ध्र n. (-न्ध्रं) 1 A hole, a fissure, a cavity, a chasm. 2 A fault, a defect. E. रम to sport, aff. क्विप्, धृ to have or hold, aff. क.
रन्ध्रबभ्रु: रन्ध्रबभ्रु m. (-भ्रुः) A rat. E. रन्ध्र a hole, and बभ्रु an ichneumon.
रप: रप r. 1st cl. (रपयति) To speak, to say or tell.
रफ: रफ(इ)रफि r. 1st. cl. (रफति रंफति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To hurt, to injure or kill.
रब: रब(इ)रबि r. 1st cl. (रंबते) 1 To sound. 2 To go.
रब्ध: रब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Begun. E. रभ to begin, क्त aff.
रब्धृ: रब्धृ mfn. (-ब्धा-ब्ध्री-ब्धृ) Beginning, who or what begins. E. रभ to begin, तृच् aff.
रभ: रभ(औ)औ रभ r. 1st cl. (रभते) or more usually (आरभते) To begin, to make a beginning, to begin willingly, &c. 2 To be pleased with. (इ) रभि r. 1st cl. (रंभते) To sound. With परि prefixed, To embrace.
रभस: रभस m. (-सः) 1 Speed, velocity. 2 Joy, delight. 3 Consideration of causes and events, or the past and future. 4 Regret, sorrow for something lost or absent. E. रभ to begin, असच् Uṇādi aff.
रम: रम(औ, उ) औरमु r. 1st cl. (रमते) To sport or play; with some prefixes this root forms an active verb, as with आङ्, उप, and वि; आरमति to rest, to repose, &c.; with उप the form is optional, if the sense is intransitive, as (उपरमति or -ते) To stop or cease.

रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Dear, beloved. 2 Pleasing, delighting, charming. m. (-मः) 1 A husband, a lover. 2 The deity of love, KĀMA. 3 A sort of tree called a red variety of the Aśoka, (Jonesia asoca.) f. (-मा) 1 A name of LAKṢMĪ. 2 A wife, a mistress. E. रम to sport, aff. अच्.
रमक: रमक m. (-कः) A lover, a gallant. E. रम to sport, क्वुन् aff.
रमठ: रमठ n. (-ठं) Asafoetida. E. रम to sport, अठन् aff.
रमण: रमण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Causing pleasure, pleasing, charming, delightful. n. (-णं) 1 Sporting, playing. 2 Dalliance, amorous sport. 3 Coition, copulation. 4 The mons veneris. 5 A sort of cucumber. m. (-णः) 1 A name of KĀMA or love. 2 A husband. 3 A lover, a gallant. 4 An ass. f. (-णा or -णी) 1 A woman, or an agreeable woman, a wife, a mistress, &c. 2 A kind of metre, having eleven syllables in the first and third, and twelve in the second and fourth Pādas of every stanza. E. रम to sport, युच् or ल्युट् aff., fem. aff. टाप् or ङीष्.
रमणीय: रमणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Beautiful, pleasing. E. रम to please, अनीयर् aff.
रमणीयता: रमणीयता f. (-ता) Agreeableness, pleasantness. E. तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, रमणीयत्वं.
रमण्य: रमण्य n. (-ण्यं) Sport, pleasure, wanton sport or dalliance. E. रम to sport, अन्य Uṇādi aff.
रमत्: रमत् mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्) Playing, sporting. E. रम to play, शतृ aff.
रमति: रमति m. (-तिः) 1 A lover, a gallant. 2 Paradise, heaven. 3 A crow. 4 Time. 5 Love or the deity KĀMA. E. रम to sport or stop, &c. Uṇādi aff. उति, but the final of the radical retained.
रममान: रममान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Sporting, playing. E. रम to please, शानच् aff.
रमापति: रमापति m. (-तिः) VIṢṆU. E. रमा LAKṢMĪ, and पति husband.
रमाप्रिय: रमाप्रिय n. (-यं) The lotus. E. रमा LAKṢMĪ, and प्रिय beloved.
रम्भ: रम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 A bambu. 2 The name of a monkey. f. (-म्भा) 1 A plantain. 2 One of the Apsaras or courtezans of Svarga. 3 A harlot, a whore. 4 A name of GAURĪ. 5 Lowing, as of a cow. E. रभि to sound, to begin, &c., aff. अच्.
रम्भक: रम्भक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Begining, who or what begins. 2 Sounding. E. रभि to sound, ण्वुल् aff.
रम्भित: रम्भित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sounded. n. (-तं) Lowing, (of kine.) E. रभि to sound, &c., क्त aff.
रम्य: रम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) 1 Pleasing, delightful, agreeable, charming. 2 Handsome. m. (-म्यः) The champaca, (Michelia champaca.) f. (-म्या) 1 Night. 2 The name of a river. n. (-म्यं) 1 The root of a species of cucumber. 2 Semen virile. E. रम to sport, aff. यत्.
रम्यक: रम्यक n. (-कं) 1 One of the minor Dvīpas or divisions of the world, lying to the north of Ilāvṛta; also called रमणक, and रमण्यक. 2 The root of the Paṭola, a sort of cucumber. E. रम्य agreeable, and कन् added.
रम्यता: रम्यता f. (-ता) 1 Agreeableness, pleasantness. 2 Gracefulness, beauty. E. रम्य with तल् aff.; also with त्व, रम्यत्वं.
रम्र: रम्र m. (-म्रः) 1 Purple, or the colour of the dawn. 2 Beauty, splendor. E. रम to please, aff. रन्.
रय: रय r. 1st cl. (रयते) To go, to move.
रय m. (-यः) 1 Speed, velocity. 2 The stream or current of a river. E. रय to go, घ aff.
रयिष्ठ: रयिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Fleetest, very fleet. m. (-ष्ठः) 1 KUVERA. 2 Fire or AGNI. 3 BRAHMĀ. E. रय speed used attributively, quick, and इष्ठन् aff. of the superlative.
रल्लक: रल्लक m. (-कः) 1 A blanket. 2 An eye-lash. 3 A sort of deer. E. रम to please, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् with the final dropped रत् comfort, pleasure, ला to give, aff. क्विप्-रल्ल, and कन् added.
रव: रव(इ)रवि r. 1st cl. (रम्बति) To go, to move.
रव m. (-वः) Sound in general, cry, noise, &c. E. रु to cry out, to sound, aff. अप्.
रवण: रवण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Sounding, sonorous. 2 Hot, warm. 3 Unsteady, fickle or shaking. 4 Jesting, a jester. m. (-णः) A camel. 2 The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. n. (-णं) 1 Bell-metal. 2 Sounding. E. रु to sound, Uṇādi aff. युच्.
रवथ: रवथ m. (-थः) The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. रु to cry or sound, Uṇādi aff. अथन्.
रवि: रवि m. (-विः) 1 The sun. 2 The right canal for the passage of the vital air. E. रु to sound, passive form, to be praised or glorified, Uṇādi aff. इन्.
रविकान्त: रविकान्त m. (-न्तः) The sun-stone, a sort of crystal. E. रवि the sun, and कान्त in this compound, a mineral.
रविनन्दन: रविनन्दन m. (-नः) The monkey chief SUGRĪVA. E. रवि the sun, and नन्दन a son.
रविनाथ: रविनाथ n. (-थः) A lotus. m. (-थः) A flower, (Pentapetes phoenicea.) E. रवि the sun, and नाथ lord.
रविन्द: रविन्द n. (-न्दं) Lotus. E. रवि the sun, and दा to give, aff. खच्.
रविप्रिय: रविप्रिय n. (-यं) 1 Copper. 2 The red lotus. m. (-यः) A plant, (Artocarpus lacucha.) E. रवि the sun, and प्रिय beloved.
रविमण्डल: रविमण्डल n. (-लं) The disk of the sun. E. रवि, and मण्डल circle.
रविमार्ग: रविमार्ग m. (-र्गः) The sun's path. E. रवि, and मार्ग road.
रविमार्गभङ्ग: रविमार्गभङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) Very high, stopping the course of the sun. E. रविमार्ग, and भङ्ग what breaks.
रविलोह: रविलोह n. (-हं) Copper. E. रवि the sun, and लोह iron.
रविवार: रविवार m. (-रः) Sunday. E. रवि, and वार a time.
रविसंज्ञक: रविसंज्ञक n. (-कं) Copper. E. रवि the sun, and संज्ञक appellation.
रशना: रशना f. (-ना) 1 The tongue. 2 A woman's girdle or zone. E. see रसन.
रश्मि: रश्मि m. (-श्मिः) 1 A ray of light. 2 A rein. 3 An eye-lash. E. अश to pervade, Uṇādi aff. मि, and रश substituted for the radical.
रश्मिजाल: रश्मिजाल n. (-लं) A blaze or stream of light. E. रश्मि, and जाल heap.
रस: रस r. 1st cl. (रसति) To sound. r. 10th cl. (रसयति) 1 To taste, to relish. 2 To love, to regard.

रस m. (-सः) 1 Flavour, taste, as sweet, salt, pungent, bitter, sour, and astringent. 2 Taste, sentiment, emotion, as an object of poetry or composition; eight sentiments are usually enumerated, Śṛṅgāra or love, Hāsya or mirth, Karuṇā or tenderness, Raudra or anger, Vīra or heroism, Bhayānaka or terror, BIbhatsA or disgust, and Adbhuta or surprise: Śānta, tranquillity or content, or Vātsalya, paternal tenderness, is sometimes considered as the ninth. 3 Affection of the mind, passion. 4 Juice, exudation, a fluid, a liquid, or liquified substance. 5 Poison. 6 Semen virile. 7 Water. 8 The primary or essential juice or fluid of the body, whence blood, serum, sweat, &c. are supposed to be engendered; it corresponds best with chyle, but is probably of a fanciful nature. 9 Gum myrrh. 10 Quicksilver, from its being a semi-fluid metal, and according to certain alchymical notions possessed of supernatural power over the juices of the body, &c. 11 A mineral or a metallic salt, as sulphur, borax, talc, blue or green vitriol, &c.; they are however usually called Upa or inferior Rasas. f. (-सा) 1 The earth. 2 The tongue. 3 A plant, commonly Aknadhi, (Cissampelos hexandra.) 4 A sort of grain, (Panicum italicum.) 5 The frankincense tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) 6 The grape. 7 A medical drug, commonly Kākoli. E. रस to taste, to love, &c., aff. अच्.
रसक: रसक m. (-कः) Stewed or boiled meat. E. रस juice, aff. कन्.
रसकर्पूर: रसकर्प्पूर n. (-रः) A white sublimate or a muriate of mercury, made in close vessels with sulphur, mercury, and common salt; the crystals formed in the first operation are sublimed a second time, which seems to be the only essential difference between this and the preparations called Rasapuṣpa; ut infra. E. रस mercury, and कर्प्पूर camphor; from its white colour.
रसकर्प्पूर: रसकर्प्पूर n. (-रः) A white sublimate or a muriate of mercury, made in close vessels with sulphur, mercury, and common salt; the crystals formed in the first operation are sublimed a second time, which seems to be the only essential difference between this and the preparations called Rasapuṣpa; ut infra. E. रस mercury, and कर्प्पूर camphor; from its white colour.
रसकला: रसकला f. (-ला) 1 A low sweet sound. 2 Singing upon intoxication. E. रस taste or vinous juice, and कला a note.
रसकेसर: रसकेसर n. (-रं) Camphor. E. रस juice, and केसर a filament.
रसगन्ध: रसगन्ध m. (-न्धः) Gum myrrh. E. रस exudation, गन्ध fragrance; also with कन् added, रसगन्धक.
रसगर्भ: रसगर्भ n. (-र्भं) 1 A mineral preparation used as a stibium. 2 Vermilion. E. रस quicksilver, and गर्भ embryo.
रसज: रसज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born or produced by or in passion, flavour, fluids, &c. n. (-जं) Blood. m. (-जः) 1 Any insect engendered by  the acetous fermentation of liquids. 2 Molasses, treacle. E. रस juice, the primary juice or chyle, &c., and ज born.
रसज्ञ: रसज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Discriminating or acquainted with tastes, sentiments, &c. m. (-ज्ञः) 1 A poet, a writer who understands the different Rasas or sentiments to be described. 2 An alchymist, one who has obtained a command over the magical properties of mercury. 3 A physician, a medical preparer and administerer of mercurial and chemical compounds. f. (-ज्ञा) The tongue. E. रस as above, and ज्ञ who or what knows.
रसज्ञता: रसज्ञता f. (-ता) 1 Poetical skill or taste. 2 Knowledge of flavours. 3 Alchymy. E. रसज्ञ, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रसज्ञत्वं.
रसज्येष्ठ: रसज्येष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) 1 The sweet flavour or taste, sweetness. 2 The sentiment of love. E. रस taste or sentiment, and ज्येष्ठ eldest, best.
रसत्: रसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) 1 Speaking, sounding. 2 Tasting, having flavour. E. रस to sound, शतृ aff.
रसतेजस्: रसतेजस् n. (-जः) The blood. E. रस chyle, and तेजस् light, strength.
रसधातु: रसधातु n. (-तु) Quicksilver. E. रस fluid, and धातु metal.
रसन: रसन n. (-नं) 1 Tasting, taste. 2 Sound, noise. f. (-ना) 1 The tongue. 2 A plant, commonly Rasan. 3 A woman's girdle, a sort of chain worn round the loins. 4 A plant, (Pæderia foetida.) E. रस to sound or taste, aff. युच्; or अश to eat, युच् Uṇādi aff., and रश substituted; also रशना.
रसनाथ: रसनाथ m. (-थः) Quicksilver. E. रस juice, fluid, and नाथ chief.
रसनायक: रसनायक m. (-कः) ŚIVA. E. रस mercury, नायक leader.
रसनालिह्: रसनालिह् m. (-लिट्) A dog. E. रसना the tongue, and लिह to lick, aff. क्विप्.
रसनिवृत्ति: रसनिवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Loss of taste, flavour, &c. E. रस, and निवृत्ति cessation.
रसनेत्रिका: रसनेत्रिका f. (-का) Red arsenic. E. रस mercury, नेत्र the eye, कन् added, fem. form.
रसपुष्प: रसपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) A preparation of mercury, a kind of muriate formed by subliming in close vessels, a mixture of sulphur, mercury, and common salt. E. रस mercury, and पुष्प flower.
रसफल: रसफल m. (-लः) The cocoanut tree. E. रस water or juice, and फल the fruit, the nut containing a saccharine fluid.
रसभङ्ग: रसभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Interruption or destruction of passion or sentiment, &c. E. रस, and भङ्ग a breaking.
रसभव: रसभव n. (-वं) The blood. E. रस chyle, and भव produced.
रसभस्मन्: रसभस्मन् n. (-स्म) Calx or oxid of mercury. E. रस, and भस्मन ashes.
रसयित्वा: रसयित्वा ind. Having tasted. E. रस to taste, क्त्वाच् aff.
रसराज: रसराज m. (-जः) Quicksilver. E. रस a mineral, and राज sovereign.
रसवत्: रसवत् ind. Including a secondary or subsidiary feeling or passion. E. रस, and वति aff.
रसवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Juicy. 2 Well-flavoured. 3 Tasteful, applied to a composition, &c. f. (-ती) A kitchen. E. रस juice, flavour, &c., मतुप् aff.
रसविक्रय: रसविक्रय m. (-यः) Selling juices or liquors, as the juice of the sugar cane, or wine, &c. E. रस juice, and विक्रय sale.
रसशोधन: रसशोधन m. (-नः) Borax. E. रस a metal, &c., and शोधन purifying; being used as a flux in refining and melting metals.
रससिद्ध: रससिद्ध m. (-द्धः) An alchymist, an adept: see the next. E. रस mercury, and सिद्ध accomplished.
रससिद्धि: रससिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) The knowledge of alchymy, the possession of peculiar familiarity with mercury, obtained by the performance of chemical operations conjoined with certain mystical and magical rites, and the securing thence to the adept, of happiness, health, and wealth, the power of transmuting metals, and the art of prolonging life. E. रस mercury, and सिद्धि accomplishment, especially of some supernatural object.
रसान्तर: रसान्तर n. (-रं) Change or diversion of passion or sentiment. E. रस, and अन्तर different.
रससिन्दूर: रससिन्दूर n. (-रं) A sort of factitious cinnabar, made with zinc, mercury, blue vitriol, and nitre, fused together; the compound is used as an escharotic. E. रस mercury, and सिन्दूर minium.
रसस्थान: रसस्थान n. (-नं) Cinnabar or vermilion. E. रस mercury, and स्थान abode.
रसाखन: रसाखन m. (-नः) A cock. E. रसा the earth, and खन who digs or picks.
रसाञ्जन: रसाञ्जन n. (-नं) A sort of collyrium, prepared either with the calx of brass, or with the Amomum anthorrhiza. E. रस juice, &c., अञ्जन collyrium.
रसातल: रसातल n. (-लं) 1 Pātāla; the seven infernal regions under the earth, and the residence of the Nāgas, Asuras, Daityas, and other races of monstrous and demoniacal beings, under the various governments of Śeṣa, Bali, and other chiefs: this is not to be confounded with Naraka or Tartarus, the proper hell or abode of guilty mortals after death. 2 The lowest of the seven divisions of Pātāla. E. रसा the earth, and तल below, underneath.
रसादान: रसादान n. (-नं) 1 Sucking, suction. 2 Drying, drying up, absorbing. E. रसा water or juice, &c., आदान taking.
रसाधार: रसाधार m. (-रः) The sun. E. रस water, आधार receptacle.
रसाभास: रसाभास m. (-सः) Concealment of sentiment, attributing evident emotions to some cause different from the real one. E. रस sentiment, and आभास unreal exposition or display.
रसाभिनिवेश: रसाभिनिवेश m. (-शः) Accession of sentiment or passion. E. रस, and अभिनिवेश intentness.
रसायक: रसायक m. (-कः) A sort of grass, (Saccharum munja.)
रसायन: रसायन n. (-नं) 1 Alchymy, chemistry. 2 The employment of mercury in medicine. 3 A medicine preventing old age, and prolonging life, the Elixir Vitœ of the alchymists. 4 Poison. 5 Butter-milk. m. (-नः) 1 GARUḌA. 2 An anthelmintic drug commonly Vireng, (Embelia ribes?) 3 An alchymist. f. (-नी) A vessel conveying nutrition, a lacteal, an absorbent. E. रस juice, quicksilver, &c., and अयन a road, a going, &c.
रसायनफला: रसायनफला f. (-ला) Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) E. रसायन juice, abiding, and फला fruit.
रसाल: रसाल m. (-लः) 1 The sugar-cane. 2 The mango tree, (Mangifera Indica.) 3 The jack tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.) 4 The Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) 5 Wheat. n. (-लं) 1 Frankincense. 2 Gum myrrh. f. (-ला) 1 The tongue. 2 Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon.) 3 A flower, (Hedysarum gangeticum.) 4 A grape. 5 Curds mixed up with sugar and spices. E. रस juice, आङ् before ला to yield, aff. क.
रसालसा: रसालसा f. (-सा) A tubular vessel of the body, a nerve, a tendon, &c.
रसास्वादिन्: रसास्वादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Tasting, relishing. 2 Sensitive, having taste. m. (-दी) A bee. E. रस flavour, and आस्वादिन् who tastes.
रसाह्व: रसाह्व n. (-ह्वः) Turpentine, resin. E. रस juice, and आह्व appellation.
रसिक: रसिक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) 1 Flavoured, having taste or flavour. 2 Tasteful, as a composition, &c. 3 Having a taste for poetry, &c. 4 Sentimental. 5 Impassioned. m. (-कः) 1 A horse. 2 An elephant. 3 A libertine. f. (-का) 1 Curds with sugar and spice. 2 Molasses, the juice of the sugar-cane. 3 The tongue. 4 A woman's zone or girdle. E. रस flavour, sentiment, and ठन् aff.
रसित: रसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gilded, plated, washed or spread with gold, &c. 2 Sounded. 3 Having taste, or flavour, or sentiment. m. (-तः) 1 The rattling of thunder. 2 Voice, sound in general. 3 Wine, vinous liquor. E. रस to sound, aff. क्त, or रस fluid, (metal, &c,) and इतच् aff.
रसितवत्: रसितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Tasting, having tasted, or having a taste for. 2 Sounding. E. रस to have flavour, क्तवतु aff.
रसिताशिन्: रसिताशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) 1 Eating or seizing with a noise or roar. 2 Drinking wine. E. रसित, and आशिन् who eats.
रसितृ: रसितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 1 Sounding, making a noise. 2 Tasting, relishing. E. रस to sound, तृच् aff.
रसिन्: रसिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) 1 Tasting. 2 Impassioned. 3 Humorous. E. रस, and इनि aff.
रसुन: रसुन m. (-नः) Garlick. E. see लसुन, र being changed to ल.
रसेन्द्र: रसेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 Quicksilver. 2 The philosopher's stone, the touch of which turns iron to gold. E. रस a mineral, and इन्द्र best.
रसोत्पत्ति: रसोत्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Production of taste or flavour. 2 Development of passion or sentiment. 3 Generation of the vital fluids. E. रस, and उत्पत्ति production.
रसोन: रसोन m. (-नः) A kind of garlick, (Allium ascalonicum.) E. रस flavour, taste, ऊन to be less or deficient, aff. अच्, being supposed to contain in the leaves, stalk, root, &c., every flavour except sourness; also with कन् added, रसोनक.
रसोपल: रसोपल n. (-लं) A pearl. E. रस water, and उपला a stone.
रस्न: रस्न n. (-लं) Thing, substance. E. रस juice, &c., and नक् Uṇādi aff.
रस्य: रस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Juicy. n. (-स्यं) Blood. E. रस chyle, यत् aff.
रह: रह r. 1st cl. (रहति) r. 10th. cl. (रहयति) To quit, to leave, to forego, to lose or abandon. With वि, To be separate or away from. (इ) रहि r. 1st cl. (रंहति) To go, to move with speed.
रह m. (-हः) Solitariness, privacy. E. रह to be private, अच् aff.
रहण: रहण n. (-णं) Quitting, leaving. E. रह to leave, ल्युट् aff.
रहत्: रहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) Leaving, abandoning. E. रह to leave, शतृ aff.
रहस्: रहस् n. subst. (-हः) 1 Solitariness, privacy. 2 Copulation. 3 A privity. 4 A religious or mystic truth. ind. or n. adv. (-हः) Solitary, private, in private, secretly, privily. E. रह to abandon, (society, &c.,) and असुन् aff., or रम to sport or play, with the same aff., and अह substituted for the radical finals.
रहस: रहस m. (-सः) 1 The ocean. 2 Heaven. E. रह to leave, असच् aff.
रहस्य: रहस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Private, secret, either fit to be concealed or occurring in secret. n. (-स्यं) A secret, a mystery, any thing hidden, recondite or mysterious. f. (-स्या) The name of a river, perhaps the Sarasvatī, from its being supposed to flow in an unknown channel. E. रहस् secret, and यत् aff.
रहाट: रहाट m. (-टः) 1 A counsellor, a minister. 2 A ghost, a spirit. 3 Spring. E. रह privately, अट to go, aff. अच्.
रहित: रहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Left, quitted, abandoned. 2 Free from, devoid of. E. रह to leave, aff. क्त.
रहीभूत: रहीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Alone, solitary, in private. E. रह, and भूत been, with च्चि aug.
रा: रा r. 2nd cl. (राति) 1 To get, to gain, to receive. 2 To give.
राका: राका f. (-का) 1 Full moon, or the day of full moon. 2 A girl in whom menstruation has commenced. 3 Scab, itch. 4 The name of a river. E. रा to give, (good fortune,) क Uṇādi aff.
राक्षस: राक्षस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Infernal, demoniacal. m. (-सः) An evil spirit, a demon, a vampire, a fiend, but who appears to be of various descriptions, and is either a powerful Titan or enemy of the gods in a superhuman or incarnate form, as RĀVAṆA and others; an attendant on KUVERA, and guardian of his treasures; or a mischievous and cruel goblin or ogre, haunting cemeteries, animating dead bodies, and devouring human beings. f. (-सी) 1 A female fiend; the female of the preceding. 2 A large tooth, a tusk. 3 A sort of perfume, commonly Cor. n. (-सं) 1 A form of marriage, the violent seizure and rape of a girl after the repulse or destruction of her relatives. 2 Surgery, cure by the knife or cautery. E. रक्ष to preserve, to be preserved, (from whom,) aff. असुन्, and अण् pleonasm added; or रक्षस् a demon, and अण् aff. of reference.
राक्षसेन्द्र: राक्षसेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 The demon RĀVAṆA. 2 KUVERA. E. राक्षस a demon, and इन्द्र lord.
राक्षा: राक्षा f. (-क्षा) Lac, the red animal dye. E. रक्ष to preserve, (colour,) अ aff., and the vowel made long.
राख: राख(ऋ)राखृ r. 1st cl. (रालति) 1 To be dry or arid. 2 To adorn. 3 To suffice, to be able or competent. 4 To impede or prevent.
राग: राग m. (-गः) 1 Colour, hue, tint, dye. 2 Affection, prepossession, love, desire. 3 Mental affection in general, as sorrow, joy, &c. 4 Envy, impatience of another's success. 5 A mode of music; of which six are enumerated, viz. Bhairava, Mālava, Sāraṅga, Hindola, Vasanta, Dīpaka, and Megha; they are personified in poetry and mythology. 6 A king, a sovereign. 7 The Raja Guṇa, the property or quality of passion. 8 Greediness, cupidity. 9 Colouring, painting, dying. f. (-गा) A sort of grain, commonly Raggy, much cultivated in the south of India, (Eleusine corocana, or Cynosurus corocanus.) E. रञ्ज to colour, &c., aff. घञ्.
रागचूर्ण: रागचूर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 A name of KĀMA. 2 A tree yielding an astringent resin or extract, the wood of which is used in dying, (Mimosa catechu.) 3 Red lead. 4 The red powder thrown over one another by the Hindus, at the vernal festival named Holī. E. राग passion or colour, and चर्ण powder.
रागच्छन्न: रागछन्न m. (-न्नः) RĀMA. E. राग, and छन्न covered.
रागछन्न: रागछन्न m. (-न्नः) RĀMA. E. राग, and छन्न covered.
रागद: रागद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Colouring. 2 Inspiring passion. f. (-दा) Crystal. E. राग colour, दा to give, अङ् and टाप् affs.
रागरज्जु: रागरज्जु m. (-ज्जुः) The deity of love, KĀMA. E. राग passion, desire, and रज्जु a rope.
रागलता: रागलता f. (-ता) The wife of KĀMADEVA. E. राग passion, desire, and लता a creeping plant.
रागवत्: रागवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Coloured. 2 Impassioned. E. राग, and मतुप् aff.
रागवृन्त: रागवृन्त mfn. (-न्तः) KĀMADEVA. E. राग passion, and वृन्त the stalk of a flower, the support.
रागषाढव: रागषाढव m. (-वः) A sweetmeat of unripe mangoes dressed with treacle and oil.
रागसूत्र: रागसूत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 The thread or string of a balance. 2 A string or thread of silk. 3 Any coloured thread or string. E. राग colour, and सूत्र a thread.
रागान्वित: रागान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Affected by passion. 2 Coloured. E. राग, and अन्वित possessed of.
रागार्ह: रागार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) 1 One who excites hopes and disappoints them. 2 Who or what is an object of affection. E. राग, and अर्ह fit.
रागाशनि: रागाशनि m. (-निः) A Jina or Jaina saint. E. राग passion, अश to throw (away), अनि aff.
रागिन्: रागिन् m. (-गी-गिणी-गि) 1 Passionate, impassioned. 2 Colouring, painting. 3 Coloured, dyed. m. (-गी) 1 A dyer, a painter. 2 A libertine, a lover. f. (-णी) 1 A shrewd and intriguing woman. 2 A modification of a musical mode, of which five are assigned to each mode; in mythology, personified as a female, and the wife of the Rāga. E. राग passion, and इनि aff., or रञ्ज to colour, &c., and धिनुण् aff.
राघ: राघ (ऋ,) राघृ r. 1st cl. (राघते) To be able or equal to.
राघव: राघव m. (-वः) 1 A name of RĀMACANDRA. 2 A sort of fish. E. रघु the ancestor of the demigod, and अण् aff. of descent.
राङ्कव: राङ्कव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Woollen, made of the hair of a sort of deer or any other animal. n. (-वं) A woollen garment. E. रङ्कु a kind of deer, and अण् aff.
राज: राज (ऋ,) राजृ r. 1st cl. (राजते or irregularly रेजते) To shine: With निर् prefixed, To overcome, to subdue.
राज्: राज् m. (राट्) A king, a monarch or prince. E. राज to shine, aff. क्विप्.
राजक: राजक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Ruling, a ruler. 2 Splendid, irradiating, bright in itself, and the cause of brilliancy in others. n. (-कं) An assemblage of princes. E. राजन् a prince, and वुञ् aff. of multitude; or राज to shine, aff. वुन्.
राजकर: राजकर n. (-रं) Tax or toll imposed by the king. E. राज, and कर tribute.
राजकदम्ब: राजकदम्ब m. (-म्बः) A sort of Kadamba. E. राज royal, कदम्ब Nauclea.
राजकशेरु: राजकशेरु m. (-रुः) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.) E. राज royal, कशेरु scirpus.
राजकार्य: राजकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Royal duties, state affairs. E. राज, and कार्य्यं act.
राजकार्य्य: राजकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Royal duties, state affairs. E. राज, and कार्य्यं act.
राजकीय: राजकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Royal, kingly. E. राजन a king, क substituted for the final, and छ aff.
राजकुल: राजकुल n. (-लं) A royal race. m. (-लः) A prince, a king. E. राज, and कुल family.
राजकुष्माण्ड: राजकुष्माण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. राज royal, and कुष्माण्ड a gourd.
राजकृत्वन्: राजकृत्वन् m. (-त्वा) A king-maker, one who raises him to the throne, &c. E. राजन्, and कृ to make, क्वनिप् aff.
राजगामिन्: राजगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going to the prince or ruler, devolving or falling to the king, (as property, &c. to which there are no heirs.) E. राज the king, and गामिन् what goes.
राजगुरु: राजगुरु m. (-रुः) The king's spiritual preceptor. E. राज a king, and गुरु preceptor.
राजग्रीव: राजग्रीव m. (-वः) A sort of flat fresh water fish, commonly Phalai. E. राज shining, ग्रीव the neck.
राजघ: राजघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) Sharp, hot. m. (-घः) A king-killer, a slayer of sovereigns, a regicide. E. राज a king, and घ for घ्न, who kills.
राजचिह्नक: राजचिह्नक n. (-कं) The male or female organs of generation. E. राज chief, चिह्न mark, and कन् aff.
राजजक्ष्मन्: राजजक्ष्मन् m. (-क्ष्मा) Pulmonary consumption. E. राज royal, principal, and जक्ष्मन् for यक्ष्मन् consumption; also राजयक्ष्मन्.
राजजम्बू: राजजम्बू f. (-म्बूः) 1 A large kind of eugenia or rose apple. 2 A sort of date tree. E. राज royal, and जम्बू Eugenia.
राजत: राजत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Silver, made of silver, &c. E. रजत silver, and अञ् aff.
राजतान्वित: राजतान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Plated, inlaid. E. राजत, and अन्वित having.
राजताल: राजताल m. (-लः) The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel.) E. राज royal, and ताल palm.
राजतिमिष: राजतिमिष m. (-षः) A cucumber. E. राज royal, and तिमिष a kind of gourd; it is also read राजतेमिष.
राजतेजस्: राजतेजस् n. (-जः) Majesty, kingly dignity. E. राज, and तेजस् splendor.
राजत्व: राजत्व n. (-त्वं) Sovereignty, royalty. E. राज a king, त्व aff. of the abstract; also with तल्, राजता.
राजदण्ड: राजदण्ड n. (-ण्डं) 1 Punishment ordered by the king. 2 A baton, a sceptre. E. राज, and दण्ड a staff, &c.
राजदन्त: राजदन्त m. (-न्तः) An upper and foretooth, applied to the two middle ones. E. राज royal, and दन्त tooth.
राजदर्शन: राजदर्शन n. (-नं) A levee, an audience. E. राज, and दर्शन seeing.
राजदेशीय: राजदेशीय m. (-यः) A petty prince or chief, one something less than a king. E. राज a king, and देशीयर् aff. implying something less or defective, or with देश्य aff. of the same power, राजदेश्य m. (-श्यः).
राजद्वार: राजद्वार n. (-रं) The gate of the palace. E. राज for राजा king, द्वार gate.
राजद्रोह: राजद्रोह m. (-हः) 1 Oppression, tyranny. 2 Rebellion. E. राज, द्रोह violence.
राजद्रोहिन्: राजद्रोहिन् m. (-ही) A rebel, a traitor. E. राजद्रोह, and इनि aff.
राजधन: राजधन n. (-नं) Royal revenue or right to property. E. राज, and धन wealth.
राजधर्म: राजधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) 1 Royal duty. 2 The duty of the military tribe. E. राज, and धर्म्म duty.
राजधर्म्म: राजधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) 1 Royal duty. 2 The duty of the military tribe. E. राज, and धर्म्म duty.
राजधर्म्मविटु: राजधर्म्मविटु m. (-वित्) A statesman, one who knows the duties of royalty. E. राजधर्म्म, and विटु who knows.
राजधान: राजधान mf. (-नं-नी) A royal city, a capital, a metropolis. E. राज a king, धान holding, containing; also with कन् added in the n. or f. (राजधानकं-राजधानिका.)
राजधान्य: राजधान्य n. (-न्यं) A sort of grain, (Panicum frumentaceum, Rox.) E. राज royal, धान्य grain.
राजधुरा: राजधुरा f. (-रा) Royal state or function, government. E. राज, and धुरा a load.
राजन्: राजन् m. (-जा) 1 A king, a prince, a sovereign. 2 A soldier by birth, a man of the regal and military tribe. 3 A master. 4 The moon. 5 A Yakṣa. 6 INDRA. 7 (In composition,) Royal, denoting eminence or excellence. f. (-ज्ञी) 1 A queen, a princess, the wife of a king. 2 The wife of the sun. 3 Deepcoloured brass, consisting of three parts of copper to one of zinc or tin. E. राज to shine, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्.
राजनय: राजनय m. (-यः) Polity. E. राज, and नय conduct: see the next.
राजनीति: राजनीति f. (-तिः) Regal polity, civil and military government. E. राज, and नीति polity.
राजनील: राजनील n. (-लं) The emerald. E. राज royal, and नील blue.
राजन्य: राजन्य m. (-न्यः) 1 A Kṣatriya, a man of the military or regal tribe. 2 A name of AGNI or fire. 3 A tree, (Mimusops kauki, Rox.) E. राज to shine, अन्य Uṇādi aff., or राजन् a king, and यत् aff.
राजन्यक: राजन्यक n. (-कं) A number of Kṣatriyas or men of the military tribe. E. राजन्य a soldier, वुञ् aff.
राजन्वत्: राजन्वत् mfn. (-न्वान्-न्वती-न्वत्) Possessing or governed by a just and active monarch, (a country, &c.) E. राजन् a king, (or by distinction a good king,) and मतुप् poss. aff., form irr.
राजपटोल: राजपटोल m. (-लः) A kind of cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca.) E. राज royal, and पटोल the same; also with कन् added, राजपटोलक.
राजपट्ट: राजपट्ट m. (-ट्टः) 1 A gem, said to be an inferior kind of diamond brought from Viraśa Deśa, a country in the north-west of India. 2 A tiara or royal fillet. E. र ज a king, and पट्ट a bandage, worn in the tiara or diadem of a prince.
राजपत्नी: राजपत्नी f. (-त्नी) A queen. E. राज, and पत्नी wife.
राजपुत्त्र: राजपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 1 The planet MERCURY. 2 A Kṣatriya or man of the military tribe. 3 A soldier by profession, but one of a mixed birth or fabulous origin. 4 The son of a king, a prince. f. (-त्त्री) 1 Arabian jasmine. 2 A bitter gourd. 3 The musk shrew. 4 A kind of brass or bell-metal. 5 A princess. 6 A woman of the Rajput tribe. E. राज a king or the moon, and पुत्त्र a son, a child.
राजपुत्त्रिका: राजपुत्त्रिका f. (-का) 1 A kind of bird. 2 A king's daughter. E. राज a king, and पुत्त्र a child, कन् aff., fem. form.
राजपुरुष: राजपुरुष m. (-षः) A guard, a watchman, a constable, &c. E. राज, and पुरुष a man.
राजपुष्प: राजपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A plant, (Mesua ferrea.) E. राज a king, and पुष्प a flower.
राजफणिञ्झक: राजफणिञ्झक m. (-कः) The orange tree. E. राज royal, and फणिञ्झक a sort of lime.
राजफल: राजफल n. (-लं) A cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca.) E. राज royal, and फल fruit.
राजबदर: राजबदर n. (-रं) 1 A plant, (a sort of Justicia.) 2 Salt. m. (-रः) The jujube. E. राज royal, and बदर the jujube.
राजभद्रक: राजभद्रक n. (-कं) A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus) E. राज royal, and भद्रक auspicious.
राजभाज्: राजभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Belonging to or claimed by the king. E. राज, and भाज् who shares.
राजभूय: राजभूय n. (-यं) Royalty, sovereignty. E. राज a king, and भूष condition of being.
राजभृत्य: राजभृत्य m. (-त्यः) A courtier, a servant of the king, any public officer. E. राज, and भृत्य a servant.
राजभोग्य: राजभोग्य m. (-ग्यः) A tree, (Chironjia sapida, or Buchanania latifolia, Rox.) n. (-ग्यं) Mace. E. राज royal, and भोग्य enjoyment.
राजमण्डूक: राजमण्डूक m. (-कः) A large kind of frog. E. राज a king, and मण्डूक a frog.
राजमल्ल: राजमल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A king's wrestler. E. राज a king, and मल्ल a wrestler.
राजमार्ग: राजमार्ग m. (-र्गः) A royal road, one passable for horses and elephants, and forty cubits broad. E. राज a king, and मार्ग a road.
राजमाष: राजमाष m. (-षः) A kind of bean, (Dolichos catjang.) E. राज royal, and माष a sort of kidney-bean.
राजमुद्ग: राजमुद्ग m. (-द्गः) A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus.) E. राज royal, and मुद्ग P. mungo.
राजयक्ष्मन्: राजयक्ष्मन् m. (-क्ष्मा) Pulmonary consumption. E. राज chief, and यक्ष्मन् phthisis.
राजयुध्वन्: राजयुध्वन् m. (-ध्वा) An enemy, a rebel, one making war against a prince. E. राज, युध to make war, क्वनिप् aff.
राजयोग्य: राजयोग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Proper or suitable for a sovereign, princely, royal. E. राज a king, and योग्य what is fit for.
राजरङ्ग: राजरङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Silver. E. राज royal, and रङ्ग tin.
राजराज: राजराज m. (-जः) 1 A name of KUVERA. 2 An emperor, a universal monarch, or king of kings. 3 The moon. E. राज a king, (of a king or kings,) or a Yakṣa, and राज sovereign.
राजर्षि: राजर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A kind of saint; that holy and superhuman personage which a king or man of the military class may become by the practice of religious austerities; seven classes of Ṛṣis are enumerated, the Devarṣi, Brahmarṣi, Maharṣi, Paramarṣi, Rājarṣi, Kāṇḍarṣi, and Śrutarṣi: the order is variously given, but the Rājarṣi is inferior to the four preceding ones, and the two last mean the inspired saints and supposed authors of the Hindu scriptures. E. राज king, and ऋषि a saint.
राजलक्षण: राजलक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Royal insignia. 2 Any natural mark indicating royalty. E. राज, and लक्षण mark.
राजलक्ष्मन्: राजलक्ष्मन् m. (-क्ष्मा) A name of YUDHIṢṬHIRA. E. राज royal, लक्ष्मन् a mark or symbol.
राजलेख: राजलेख m. (-खः) A royal letter or order. E. राज, and लेख a writing; also राजलेख्यं, &c.
राजवंश्य: राजवंश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Of royal parentage or descent. E. राज royal, and वंश family, यत् aff.
राजवत्: राजवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Governed by a just and able monarch, (a country, &c.) 2 Royal, kingly. E. राज a king, and मतुप् aff.
राजवर्त्मन्: राजवर्त्मन् n. (-र्त्म) A royal or main road. E. राज a king, and वर्त्मन् a road.
राजवला: राजवला f. (-ला) A plant, (Pæderia foetida.) E. राज a king, and वल surrounding.
राजवल्ली: राजवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A small gourd, (Momordica charantia.) राज royal, and वल्ली a creeper.
राजवसति: राजवसति f. (-तिः) 1 A throne. 2 A palace. E. राज, and वसति abode.
राजवाह: राजवाह m. (-हः) A horse. E. राज a king, and वाह a vehicle.
राजवाह्य: राजवाह्य m. (-ह्यः) A royal elephant. E. राज a king, and वाह्य a vehicle.
राजवि: राजवि m. (-विः) The blue jay. E. राज, and वि a bird.
राजवीजिन्: राजवीजिन् mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि) Springing from a royal race. E. राज a king, वीज seed, and इनि aff.
राजवृक्ष: राजवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 The Piyāl tree, (Buchanania latifolia.) 2 A sort of tree, (Cassia fistula.) 3 Euphorbia of various kinds. E. राज royal, and वृक्ष a tree.
राजशन: राजशन m. (-नः) A plant, from the fibres of which a coarse cordage and canvas are prepared, (Corchorus capsularis or olitorius.) E. राज royal, and शन Crotolaria.
राजशफर: राजशफर m. (-रः) The Iliśa or Hilsa fish, (Clupanodon Ilisha, HAM.) E. राज king, and शफर another sort of fish.
राजशय्या: राजशय्या f. (-य्या) A royal seat or throne. E. राज a king, and शय्या a bed or couch.
राजशासन: राजशासन n. (-नं) 1 A royal edict. 2 A royal badge. E. राज, and शासन an edict.
राजशुक: राजशुक m. (-कः) A sort of parrot, (Psittacus Lori.) E. राज royal, and शुक a parrot.
राजशृङ्ग: राजशृङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The royal Catta or umbrella. m. (-ङ्गः) A sort of sheat fish, (Silurus batachus.) E. राज royal, and शृङ्ग a horn.
राजस: राजस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Relating to, or derived, &c. from the quality of passion. f. (-सी) 1 The goddess DURGĀ. 2 The state of being in this world or the next, in which the Raja Guṇa or quality of passion predominates: it is divided into three classes; the first class comprises the Gandharbas, Yakṣas, Guhyakas, &c.; the second, kings and heroes; and the third, boxers, wrestlers, gamblers, tipplers, actors, &c. E. रजस् the quality of passion, अण् and ङीप् affs.
राजसत्ता: राजसत्ता f. (-त्ता) Majesty, royal dignity. E. राज, and सत्ता existence.
राजसदन: राजसदन n. (-नं) A palace. E. राज a king, and सदन a dwelling.
राजसर्प: राजसर्प m. (-र्पः) A large kind of snake, (Boa.) E. राज, and सर्प a snake; the king of snakes.
राजसभा: राजसभा f. (-भा) A royal assembly or court. E. राज a king, and सभा assembly.
राजसर्षप: राजसर्षप m. (-पः) 1 Mustard, (Sinapis dichotoma, or S. ramosa, Rox.) 2 A mustard seed, as a measure of weight. E. राज royal, and सर्षप mustard.
राजसायुज्य: राजसायुज्य n. (-ज्यं) Royalty, sovereignty. E. राज a king, सायुज्य state.
राजसारस: राजसारस m. (-सः) A peacock. E. राज royal, and सारम the Indian crane.
राजसिंह: राजसिंह m. (-हः) A great king. E. राज, and सिंह a lion.
राजसूय: राजसूय n. (-यं) 1 A sacrifice performed only by a universal monarch, attended by his tributary princes; as in the case of YUDHIṢṬHIRA, and others. 2 A lotus. 3 A mountain. 4 A sort of rice. E. राज a king, (by him,) and षू to be produced, to be effected, aff. क्यप्; or राज the moon, for the moon plant, of which the acid juice is drank at the ceremony, and सु to bring forth, the same aff., deriv. irr.
राजसूयक: राजसूयक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to a royal sacrifice. E. कन added to the last.
राजसूययाजिन्: राजसूययाजिन् m. (-जी) A priest officiating at the royal sacrifice. E. राजसूय, and याजिन् who sacrifices.
राजसेवक: राजसेवक m. (-कः) A courtier, a royal attendant. E. राज, and सेवक a servant.
राजस्कन्ध: राजस्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) A horse. E. राज a king, and स्कन्ध the shoulder.
राजस्व: राजस्व n. (-स्वं) Royal revenue, impost, duty, tax. E. राज, and स्व own.
राजहंस: राजहंस m. (-सः) 1 A white goose with red legs and bill, or more properly perhaps the flamingo. 2 A drake. 3 An excellent king. E. राज, and हंस a goose, the king goose.
राजहर्षण: राजहर्षण n. (-णं) A city, a town. E. राज a king, and हर्षण delighting.
राजहस्तिन्: राजहस्तिन् m. (-ली) A royal elephant. E. राज a king, and हस्तिन् an elephant.
राजहासक: राजहासक m. (-कः) A sort of large fish, (Cyprinus niloticus.) E. राज a king, हासक diverting, pleasing.
राजाज्ञा: राजाज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) A royal edict or command. E. राज, and आज्ञा order.
राजातन: राजातन m. (-नः) A tree, (Buchanania latifolia.) E. राज a king, and आङ् before तन to stretch, aff. अच्.
राजादन: राजादन m. (-नः) 1 A tree, (Buchanania latifolia.) 2 Another tree, (Mimusops kauki.) 3 The Kiṃśuka, (Butea frondosa.) E. राज a king, and अदन eating; also राजातन, and राजादनफल.
राजाधिराज: राजाधिराज m. (-जः) A paramount sovereign. E. राजा, and अधिराज superior prince.
राजान्न: राजान्न m. (-न्नः) A sort of rice, of a superior quality, said to grow in the Āndhra country. E. राज, and अन्न food.
राजाम्र: राजाम्र m. (-म्रः) A superior sort of mango. E. राज royal, अम्र mango.
राजार्क: राजार्क m. (-र्कः) Gigantic swallow wort. (Asclepias gigantea, with white flowers.) E. राज royal, and अर्क swallow wort.
राजार्ह: राजार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Royal, noble, fit or proper for a king. n. (-र्हं) Aloe wood, (Amyris agallocha, Rox.) E. राज a sovereign, and अर्ह proper.
राजालुक: राजालुक m. (-कः) An esculent root, a sort of yam. E. राज royal, आलु a yam, कन् added.
राजावर्त: राजावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A gem, described as an inferior kind of diamond, brought from the country Virāṭa. E. राज a king, आवर्त्तं a turning; it is considered as a lucky possession for princes, though not esteemed as an ornament.
राजावर्त्त: राजावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A gem, described as an inferior kind of diamond, brought from the country Virāṭa. E. राज a king, आवर्त्तं a turning; it is considered as a lucky possession for princes, though not esteemed as an ornament.
राजावलि: राजावलि f. (-लिः-ली) A line of kings, a royal dynasty or genealogy. E. राज, and आवली a line.
राजाहि: राजाहि m. (-हिः) A sort of snake said to be two-headed. E. राज royal, and अहि a snake.
राजि: राजि f. (-जिः-जी) 1 A row, a line. 2 An unbroken row, a continuous line. 3 A small vessel of the body. E. राज to shine, इज् Uṇādi aff., ङीष् optionally added.
राजिका: राजिका f. (-का) 1 Black mustard, (Sinapis racemosa, Rox.) 2 A field. 3 A line, a row, a range. 4 A continuous or unbroken line. E. राज to shine, क्वुन् aff., fem. form, or राजि as above, and कन् added.
राजित: राजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Adorned, embellished. 2 Illuminated, irradiated. E. राज to shine, क्त aff.
राजिल: राजिल m. (-लः) A sort of snake, (Amphisbæna.) E. राजि a line, and लच् aff.
राजीव: राजीव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Attending on or living about a prince. m. (-वः) 1 A large fish, (Cyprinus niloticus, BUC.) 2 A kind of deer. 3 An elephant. n. (-वं) A lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum.) E. राजी a line, a row, व aff.
राजेन्द्र: राजेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) An emperor. E. राज, and इन्द्र chief.
राजेभ: राजेभ m. (-भः) A state elephant. E. राज, and इभ an elephant.
राज्य: राज्य n. (-ज्यं) 1 A government, a country, a principality, a kingdom. 2 Administration or exercise of sovereignty or government. E. राज for राजन् a prince, and यत् or यक् aff.
राज्यच्युत: राज्यच्युत m. (-तः) A prince who has lost his kingdom. E. राज्य, and च्युत fallen from.
राज्यच्युति: राज्यच्युति f. (-तिः) Deposal, loss of sovereignty. E. राज्य, and च्युति falling.
राज्यधुरा: राज्यधुरा f. (-रा) Administration, government. E. राज्य, and धुरा burthen.
राज्यभङ्ग: राज्यभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Subversion of a sovereignty. E. राज्य, and भङ्ग a breaking.
राज्यभाज्: राज्यभाज् m. (-भाक्) A king. E. राज्य, and भाज् who has.
राज्यभ्रंश: राज्यभ्रंश m. (-शः) Deposal or loss of a kingdom. E. राज्य, and भ्रंश falling.
राज्यभ्रष्ट: राज्यभ्रष्ट m. (-ष्टः) A deposed sovereign. E. राज्य, and म्रष्ट fallen.
राज्यरक्षा: राज्यरक्षा f. (-क्षा) Protection or defence of a kingdom. E. राज्य, and रक्षा preservation.
राज्यलोभ: राज्यलोभ m. (-भः) Ambition. E. राज्य, and लोभ desire.
राज्याङ्ग: राज्याङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) A requisite of regal administration; variously enumerated, as seven, eight, or nine, viz. first, the monarch; second, the prime minister; third, a friend or ally; fourth, treasure; fifth, territory; sixth, a strong hold; and seventh, an army; the eighth is the population or companies of citizens, and the ninth the Purohita or spiritual adviser. E. राज्य royalty, and अङ्ग limb or part.
राज्याधिकार: राज्याधिकार m. (-रः) 1 Government of a kingdom. 2 Right or title to a sovereignty. E. राज्य, and अधिकार superintendence, &c.
राटि: राटि f. (-टिः) War, battle. E. रट to speak, to sound, aff. इञ्.
राढा: राढा f. (-ढा) 1 Beauty, splendour, light, lustre. 2 A country or district, part of Bengal west of the Hugli river. E. रह to quit, aff. घञ्, and ह changed to ढ.
राण: राण n. (-णं) 1 A leaf. 2 A peacock's tail. E. रण to sound, aff. घञ्.
रात्रक: रात्रक n. (-कं) A period of five nights collectively. m. (-कः) A man who takes up his abode in a harlot's house for one year. E. रात्रि night, and कन् aff.
रात्रि: रात्रि f. (-त्रिः-त्री) Night. E. रा to give, (pleasure or rest,) त्रिप् Uṇādi aff., ङीप् optionally added.
रात्रिचर: रात्रिचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Going or moving at night. m. (-रः) 1 A goblin, a fiend, a ghost or evil spirit. 2 A thief, a robber. 3 A guard, a patrole. E. रात्रि night, (by night,) and चर who goes.
रात्रिज: रात्रिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Nocturnal, born or produced at night. n. (-जं) A star, a constellation. E. रात्रि night, and ज born.
रात्रिजल: रात्रिजल n. (-लं) Dew, mist, fog. E. रात्रि night, and जल water.
रात्रिजागर: रात्रिजागर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Keeping watch at night, sitting up at night. m. (-रः) A dog. E. रात्रि night, and जागर who wakes.
रात्रिजागरण: रात्रिजागरण n. (-णं) Sitting up all night. E. रात्रि, and जागरण waking.
रात्रिजागरद: रात्रिजागरद m. (-दः) A musquito, a gnat. E. रात्रिजागर waking by night, and द who gives or makes, from दा to give, or from दो to cut, who stings.
रात्रिञ्चर: रात्रिञ्चर m. (-रः) A ghost, a goblin. E. रात्रि night, चर to go, ट aff., and मुम् augment; also रात्रिचर.
रात्रिमट: रात्रिमट m. (-टः) 1 A ghost, a goblin. 2 A theif. 3 A guard. 4 A night-walker. E. रात्रि night, अट to go, aff. अच्, and मुम् augment.
रात्रिमणि: रात्रिमणि m. (-णिः) The moon. E. रात्रि night, and मणि a jewel.
रात्रिम्मन्य: रात्रिम्मन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Thinking it night. E. रात्रि, and मन्य who believes, खच् aff.
रात्रियोग: रात्रियोग m. (-गः) Coming on of night. E. रात्रि, and योग joining.
रात्रिवासस्: रात्रिवासस् n. (-सः) Darkness. E. रात्रि night, and वासस् vesture.
रात्रिविगम: रात्रिविगम m. (-मः) Dawn, day-light. E. रात्रि night, विगम stop, cessation.
रात्रिविश्लेषगामिन्: रात्रिविश्लेषगामिन् m. (-मी) The ruddy goose. E. रात्रि night, विश्लेष separation, and गामिन् who goes, these birds being supposed to pass the night apart.
