रात्रिवेद: रात्रिवेद m. (-दः) A cock. E. रात्रि the night, and वेद who knows, who knows its measure or duration.
रात्रिवेदिन्: रात्रिवेदिन् m. (-दी) A cock. E. रात्रि night, and वेदिन् who knows: see the last.
रात्रिहास: रात्रिहास m. (-सः) The white lotus. E. रात्रि night, and हास what smiles, blossoming at night.
रात्रिहिण्डक: रात्रिहिण्डक m. (-कः) A guard of the interior or women's apartments. E. रात्रि night, हिडि to go, क्वुन् aff.
रात्र्यट: रात्र्यट m. (-टः) 1 An imp, a goblin. 2 A ghost. 3 A thief. 4 A night-walker. E. रात्रि night, अट to go, aff. अच्; also with a nasal inserted, रात्रिमट.
राद्ध: राद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Cooked, dressed. 2 Perfected, as a religious vow; observed, as a fast, &c. 3 Perfect, in mysterious or magical power, adept, initiated. 4 Perfect in general, accomplished; finished, complete, mature, &c. E. राध to accomplish or be accomplished, aff. क्त.
राद्धान्त: राद्धान्त m. (-न्तः) Demonstrated truth, proved and established fact or conclusion. E. राद्ध established, अन्त end, result.
राध: राध (औ) औराध r. 4th cl. (राध्यति) 5th cl. (राध्नोति) 1 To bring any thing to fulness or completion, to finish, to effect, to accomplish, to complete. 2 To attain completion, to succeed, to be finished or accomplished. With अप prefixed, To offend, to be in fault. With आङ्, To worship, to propitiate by worship.

राध m. (-धः) The month Vaiśākha, (April-May.) f. (-धा) 1 The asterism, in which the moon is full in the month Vaiśākha; the sixteenth of the Nakṣatras, containing four stars in the shape of a festoon; the stars are supposed to be a v i Libra,  and Scorpionis. 2 A celebrated Gopī, the favourite mistress of KṚṢṆA, during his residence in Vṛndāvana amongst the cow-herds. 3 Lightning. 4 An attitude in shooting, standing with the feet a span apart. 5 Emblic myrobalan. 6 A flower, (Clitoria ternata.) E. राध to accomplish, aff. अ, टाप् fem. aff., or राधा the asterism, अण् aff. of reference.
राधन: राधन n. (-नं) 1 Completing, accomplishing, succeeding, effecting. 2 Obtaining, acquisition. 3 Pleasure, satisfaction. 4 The means or instrument of accomplishing any thing. f. (-ना) Speech, speaking. E. राध to accomplish, aff. युच्.
राधरङ्क: राधरङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 A plough. 2 Thin rain. 3 Hail.
राधाकान्त: राधाकान्त m. (-न्तः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. राधा, and कान्त beloved.
राधातनय: राधातनय m. (-यः) KARṆA. E. राधा, and तनय son; see राधासुत.
राधानाथ: राधानाथ m. (-थः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. राधा, and नाथ lord.
राधापुत्त्र: राधापुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) KARṆA E. राधा, and पुत्त्र son: see राधासुत.
राधाभेदिन्: राधाभेदिन् m. (-दी) A name of ARJUNA. E. राधा the mistress of KṚṢṆA, and भेदिन् dividing; having prevailed on KṚṢṆA to abandon her.
राधावल्लभ: राधावल्लभ m. (-भः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. राधा, and वल्लभ beloved.
राधावेधिन्: राधावेधिन् m. (-धी) ARJUNA. E. राधा the mistress of KṚṢṆA, and वेधिन् who hurts or wounds: see राधाभेदिन्.
राधासुत: राधासुत m. (-तः) KARṆA. E. राधा the name of the wife of the charioteer of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA, by whom the prince, after exposure by his own mother KUNTĪ, was found and fostered, and सुत a son.
राधेय: राधेय m. (-यः) A name of KARṆA. E. राधा a proper name, and ढक् aff.: see राधासुत.
राप्य: राप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be said or spoken. E. रप to speak, aff. ण्यत्.
राम: राम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Black. 2 White. 3 Beautiful, pleasing. m. (-मः) 1 A name common to three incarnations of VIṢṆU, or PARAŚURĀMA, the son of the Muni JAMADAGNI, born at the commencement of the second or Tretā Yug, for the purpose of punishing the tyrannical kings of the Kṣatriya race; RĀMACANDRA, the son of DAŚARATHA, king of Oude, born at the close of the second age, to destroy the demons who infested the earth, and especially RĀVAṆA the Daitya sovereign of Ceylon; and BALARĀMA, the elder and half-brother of KṚṢṆA, the son of ROHIṆĪ, born at the end of the Dvāpara or third age. 2 A name of VARUṆA, regent of the waters. 3 A horse. 4 A sort of deer. f. (-मा) 1 A woman, a female, a pleasing or beautiful female. 2 Asafoetida. 3 A river. n. (-मं) 1 A potherb, (Chenopodium album.) 2 A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.) E. रम to sport, aff. घञ्.
रामकरी: रामकरी f. (-री) One of the Rāgiṇīs, or female personifications of the musical modes. E. राम delighting, and करी who makes; also रामकली.
रामकर्पूर: रामकर्पूर m. (-रः) A fragrant sort of grass. E. राम pleasant, and कर्पूर (smelling like) camphor.
रामकली: रामकली f. (-ली) A Rāgiṇī. E. राम pleasant, कला sound or note, ङीप् aff.
रामगिरि: रामगिरि m. (-रिः) The name of a mountain, variously applied, but especially assigned to a mountain called Compteh or Citrakūṭa in Bundelkund, and to another near Nagpore, called now Rāmtek. E. राम the hero, and गिरि a mountain, the mountain of RĀMA; being one of his halting places in his progress from Oude to the Peninsula.
रामचन्द्र: रामचन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The hero RĀMACANDRA, the second incarnation of VIṢṆU under the name of RĀMA. E. राम, and चन्द्र the moon, the moon-like RĀMA.
रामजननी: रामजननी f. (-नी) The mother of BALARĀMA. E. राम, and जननी mother; hence it is equally applicable to REṆUKĀ, the mother of PARAŚURĀMA, and to KAUŚALYĀ, the mother of RĀMACANDRA.
रामठ: रामठ n. (-ठं) Asafoetida. E. रम to please, अठ Uṇādi aff., and the radical vowel lengthened.
रामणीयक: रामणीयक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Beautiful, pleasing. E. रमणीय the same, and वुञ् aff.
रामदूत: रामदूत m. (-तः) The monkey HANUMĀN, the friend and messenger of RĀMA. f. (-तिः-ती) A shrub, apparently a variety of basil with small leaves. E. राम RĀMA, and दूत a messenger.
रामपूग: रामपूग m. (-गः) A small species of the areca or betel-nut tree, (Areca triandra, Rox.) E. राम RAMA, and पूग areca.
रामभद्र: रामभद्र m. (-द्रः) The hero RĀMACANDRA. E. राम the same, and भद्र auspicious.
रामवीणा: रामवीणा f. (-णा) A sort of Vīṇā or lute. E. राम RAMA, and वीणा a lute; it may be also ironically applicable to the horn blown by BALARĀMA, and called still the Rāmsinh.
रामशर: रामशर m. (-रः) A variety of the Saccharum Sara, a sort of grass. E. राम RĀMA, and शर the Sara.
रामसख: रामसख m. (-खः) The monkey king SUGRĪVA. E. राम RĀMA, and सख friend; RĀMA having restored him to his throne, whence he had been driven by another monkey chief BALI.
रामायण: रामायण n. (-णं) 1 The first epic poem of the Hindus, recording the adventures of RĀMA the son of DAŚARATHA, sovereign of Oude; written by the poet VĀLMIKI. 2 A name of several poems on the life and adventures of RĀMA. E. राम the prince so named, and अयन abode.
रामिल: रामिल m. (-लः) 1 KĀMA or CUPID. 2 A lover, a husband. E. राम pleasing, agreeable, इलच् aff.
राम्भ: राम्भ m. (-म्भः) The bambu, staff of a religious student. E. रम्भा a bambu, aff. अञ्.
रायण: रायण n. (-णं) 1 Pain. 2 Sounding, crying, making a noise. E. रै to sound, aff. ल्युट्.
रायभाटी: रायभाटी f. (-टी) The current or flow of a river.
रारस्यमान: रारस्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Crying aloud and repeatedly. E. रस to cry, reit. v., शानच् aff.
राल: राल m. (-लः) Resin, the resinous and fragrant exudation of the Shorea robusta. E. रा to give or get, aff. अलच्; also अराल.
राव: राव n. (-वः) Sound, noise. E. रु to cry or sound, aff. घञ्.
रावण: रावण m. (-णः) The sovereign of Laṅkā or Ceylon, killed by RĀMACANDRA. n. (-णं) Noise, tumult. E. रु to cry (in the causal form), aff. ल्युट्, afflicting mankind.
रावणारि: रावणारि m. (-रिः) The hero RĀMA. E. रावण RĀVAṆA, and अरि the foe.
रावणि: रावणि m. (-णिः) The eldest son of RĀVAṆA. E. रावण, and इञ् patronymic aff.
राश: राश (ऋ,) राशृ r. 1st and 4th cls. (राशते राश्यते) To sound.
राशि: राशि m. (-शिः) 1 A heap, a quantity. 2 A sign of the zodiac. 3 Arithmetical or algebraic quantity. 4 A part and its divisor, or numerator and denominator. 5 A congeries of number or quantity. E. अश to pervade, इण् Uṇādi aff. and रुट् initial augment; or रश to sound, with the same aff.
राशिगत: राशिगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Heaped, accumulated. 2 Computed, summed either by arithmetic or algebra. E. राशि, and गत gone to.
राशिचक्र: राशिचक्र n. (-क्रं) The zodiac. E. राशि a sign, and चक्र a wheel or circle.
राशिभाग: राशिभाग m. (-गः) A fraction. E. राशि, and भाग a part.
राशिभोग: राशिभोग m. (-गः) Passage of a planet through a sign of the zodiac. E. राशि, भोग enjoyment.
राशीकरण: राशीकरण n. (-णं) Heaping, piling, gathering. E. राशि, and करण making, च्चि augment.
राशीकृत: राशीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Heaped, piled, gathered. E. राशि, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
राशीभूत: राशीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Heaped, piled. E. राशि, and भूत become, च्चि aug.
राष्ट्र: राष्ट्र mn. (-ष्ट्रः-ष्ट्रं) 1 An inhabited country or realm, a region. 2 Any public calamity, as plague, famine, &c. E. राज to shine or govern, aff. ष्ट्रन्.
राष्ट्रनिवासिन्: राष्ट्रनिवासिन् m. (-सी) An inhabitant of any civilized country. E. राष्ट्र a district, and निवासिन a dweller.
राष्ट्रिक: राष्ट्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to or inhabiting a country. f. (-का) A prickly sort of night-shade, (Solanum jacquini.) E. राष्ट्र a country, and ठन् aff.
राष्ट्रिय: राष्ट्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of or belonging to a kingdom, produced or born in it, &c. E. राष्ट्र a region, and घ aff.
राष्ट्रीय: राष्ट्रीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging or relating to a region or realm. m. (-यः) A king's brother-in-law, (in theatrical language.) E. राष्ट्र a region, छ aff.
रास: रास (ऋ) रासृ r. 1st cl. (रासते) To sound.

रास m. (-सः) 1 Confused noise, uproar, hubbub. 2 Sound in general. 3 Speech, discourse. 4 A chain. 5 A festival amongst the cowherds, including songs and dances, especially the circular dance as performed by KṚṢṆA and the Gopīs or cowherdesses. 6 A game played by children. E. रस to sound, घञ् aff.
रासभ: रासभ m. (-भः) An ass. f. (-भी) The she ass. E. रास to sound, अभच् Uṇādi aff.
रासभधूसर: रासभधूसर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Grey or light-brown, ass-grey. E. रासभ and धूसर grey.
रासभवन्दिनी: रासभवन्दिनी f. (-नी) Arabian jasmine. E. रासभ an ass, वदि to praise, aff. णिनि.
रासयात्रा: रासयात्रा f. (-त्रा) A festival in honour of KṚṢṆA on the full moon of Kārttika. E. रास, and यात्रा festival.
रासेरस: रासेरस m. (-सः) 1 An assembly, a company, a party. 2 A game or festival peculiar to the cowherds: see रास. 3 Love, desire, the passion or sentiment. 4 Alchymy: see रससिद्धि. 5 The sixth night after delivery, on which the family and friends sit up all night. 6 Sport, mirth, pastime. 7 Any festival or holiday. E. रास noise, &c., and रस flavour, taste.
रास्ना: रास्ना f. (-स्ना) 1 A plant, (Mimosa octandra.) 2 Another plant, (the serpent ophioxylon ?) 3 A sort of perfume. E. स्स to sound, नक् Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made long.
राहु: राहु m. (-हुः) The ascending node; in mythology, the son of SIṂHIKĀ, a Daitya, with the tail of a dragon, whose head was severed from his body by VIṢṆU, but being immortal, the head and tail retained their separate existence, and being transferred to the stellar sphere, became the authors of eclipses; the first especially, by endeavouring at various times to swallow the sun and moon. E. रह to abandon, (the planets which it has vainly attempted to devour,) aff. उ, and the vowel made long.
राहुग्रस्त: राहुग्रस्त m. (-स्तः) Eclipsed, (as the sun or moon.) E. राहु, and ग्रस्त seized.
राहुग्रास: राहुग्रास m. (-सः) Immersion of a planet in an eclipse. E. राहु, and ग्रास mouthful.
राहुग्राह: राहुग्राह m. (-हः) An eclipse of the sun or moon. E. राहु the dragon's head, and ग्राह seizure.
राहुभेदिन्: राहुभेदिन् m. (-दी) VIṢṆU. E. राहु the Daitya, भेदिन् the divider.
राहुमूर्द्धभिद्: राहुमूर्द्धभिद् m. (-भिद्) VIṢṆU. E. राहु the Daitya, मूर्द्ध the head, and भिट् who divides, who decapitates.
राहुलसू: राहुलसू m. (-सूः) A name of the legislator Buddha or Śākyasiṃha.
राहुसंस्पर्श: राहुसंस्पर्श m. (-र्शः) An eclipse. E. राहु the dragon's head, and संस्पर्श seizure, contact.
राहुहन्: राहुहन् m. (-हा) VIṢṆU. E. राहु the Daitya, and हन् destroyer.
राहूच्छिष्ट: राहूच्छिष्ट m. (-ष्टः) Garlick. E. राहु the demon, उच्छिष्ट vomited.
राहूत्सृष्ट: राहूत्सृष्ट m. (-ष्टः) Garlick. E. राहू the Daitya, and उत्सृष्ट created.
रि: रि r. 5th cl. (रिणोति) To hurt or injure. r. 6th cl. (रियति) To go, to move.
रि m. (रिः) 1 The tone of voice by which the note Ṛṣabha is uttered. 2 Dancing, tumbling. 3 Waste, loss. f. (रिः) Wish, desire. 4 Light, lustre. E. रा to give, &c. aff. कि.
रिक: रिक n. (-कं) 1 The heart, the mind. 2 Law, litigation. E. रिच to divide, &c., aff. क.
रिक्त: रिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Empty, void. 2 Poor, indigent. 3 Unloaded, unburthened. 4 Purged. n. (-क्तं) 1 A wood, a forest. 2 A vacuity, a vacuum. f. (-क्ता) The fourth, ninth, or fourteenth days of the lunar fortnight. E. रिच to void by stool, aff. क्त.
रिक्तक: रिक्तक m. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Void, empty. 2 Unladen, unburthened. E. कन् added to the preceding.
रिक्तता: रिक्तता f. (-ता) Vacuity, void, space. E. रिक्त, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रिक्तत्वं.
रिक्तभाण्ड: रिक्तभाण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) Having no vessels or effects. n. (-ण्डं) An empty vessel. E. रिक्त, and भाण्ड vessel.
रिक्तहस्त: रिक्तहस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Empty-handed. E. रिक्त, and हस्त hand.
रिक्थ: रिक्थ n. (-क्यं) Substance, property, wealth. E. रिच् to separate, Uṇādi aff. थक्.
रिक्थहारिन्: रिक्थहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिनी-रि) Taking or inheriting property. m. (-री) 1 An heir, one who succeeds to the property of the deceased, and gives the funeral cake. 2 A maternal uncle. 3 The seed of the Indian fig. E. रिक्थ wealth, and हारिन् who takes.
रिक्थिन्: रिक्थिन् mfn. (-क्थी-क्थिनी-क्थि) Wealthy, possessing property. m. (-क्थी) A successor or an heir. E. रिक्थ wealth, and इनि aff.
रिक्षा: रिक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 A nit. 2 A mote in a sun-beam. E. see लिक्षा, ल being changed to र.
रिख: रिख r. 1st cl. (रिखति) To go, to move.
रिख (इ) रिखि r. 1st cl. (रिंखति) To go, to move.
रिग: रिग (इ) रिगि r. 1st cl. (रिंगति) To go, to move.
रिङ्ख: रिङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) 1 Disappointing, deceiving. 2 A horse's hoof. 3 One of a horse's paces. 4 Dancing. 5 Sliding, slipping. E. रिखि to go, aff. अच्.
रिङ्खण: रिङ्खण n. (-णं) Slipping, sliding, stumbling, tumbling; or figuratively, deviating from rectitude or virtue. E. रिखि to go, aff. ल्युट्.
रिङ्गण: रिङ्गण n. (-णं) 1 Creeping, (as a child on all fours.) 2 Tumbling, slipping, sliding. 3 Deviating from rectitude, sliding from virtue. E. रिगि to go, aff. ल्युट्.
रिच: रिच r. 1st and 10 cls. (रेचति-रेचयति) To join, to unite. 2 To divide, to scatter or separate. 3 To purge. (औइर्) औ रिचिर r. 7th cl. (रिणक्ति-रिंक्ते) To purge, to evacuate fæces frequently. With अति prefixed, To exceed, to be more than enough. With वि, To purge.
रिटि: रिटि f. (-टिः) 1 The crackling or roaring of flame. 2 A musical instrument. 3 Black salt.
रिपु: रिपु m. (-पुः) An enemy. E. रप to speak, to abuse, aff. उ, and इ substituted for the radical vowel.
रिपुघातिन्: रिपुघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Killing a foe. f. (-नी) A shrub, (Abrus precatorius.) E. रिपु an enemy, and घातिन् destructive.
रिपुञ्जय: रिपुञ्जय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Victorious. m. (-यः) Name of a king. E. रिपु, जि to conquer, खच् aff.
रिपुता: रिपुता f. (-ता) Hostility, enmity. E. रिपु, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रिपुत्वं.
रिप्र: रिप्र mfn. (-प्रः-प्रा-प्रं) Vile, bad, wicked. E. री to hurt, Uṇādi aff. र, the vowel made short, and पुट् augment.
रिफ: रिफ r. 6th cl. (रिफति) 1 To speak, to say or tell. 2 To fight. 3 To blame, to censure. 4 To hurt or injure. 5 To give. 6 To praise, to flatter.
रिम्फ: रिम्फ r. 6th cl. (रिम्फति) To hurt, to injure, to kill.
रिम्फ n. (-म्फं) The zodiac. E. रिम्फ to hurt, अच् aff.
रिरंसा: रिरंसा f. (-सा) Wish to sport. E. रम to play, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
रिरंसु: रिरंसु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Desirous to sport. E. रम to sport, उ aff. desid. v.
रिरी: रिरी f. (-री) Pale brass, prince's metal, &c. E. री to go, क्रिन् aff., ङीप् added.
रिव: रिव (इ) रिवि r. 1st cl. (रिण्वति) To go, to move.
रिश: रिश r. 6th cl. (रिशति) To hurt, to injure, to kill or attempt to kill.
रिश्य: रिश्य m. (-श्यः) A deer. E. रिश to hurt, aff. क्यप्.
रिष: रिष r. 1st cl. (रेषति) r. 4th cl. (रिष्यति) To hurt, to kill, or attempt to kill. r. 9th cl. (रिष्णाति) To separate, to depart.
रिषि: रिषि n. (-षिः) A saint. E. रि substituted for ऋ; see ऋषि.
रिष्ट: रिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Hurt, injured. 2 Unlucky. 3 Lucky. n. (-ष्टं) 1 Happiness, prosperity. 2 Good luck, fortune. 3 Bad luck, ill fortune. 4 Destruction, loss, privation. 5 Sin. m. (-ष्टः) 1 A sword. 2 The soap plant. 3 A demon, destroyed by VIṢṆU. E. रिष to hurt or injure, aff. क्त.
रिष्टक: रिष्टक m. (-कः) The soap-berry plant, (Sapindus of several species.) E. रिष्ट the same, कन् added.
रिष्टि: रिष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) A sword. f. (-ष्टिः) Prosperity, good fortune. E. रिष to hurt, aff. क्तिन्.
रिष्य: रिष्य m. (-ष्यः) A deer. E. रिष to hurt, to be hurt, aff. क्यप्.
रिष्व: रिष्व mfn. (-ष्वः-ष्वा-ष्वं) Mischievous, injurious. E. रिष to hurt, Uṇādi aff. वन्, form irr.
रिह: रिह r. 1st cl. (रेहति) To hurt, to injure, to kill.
री: री r. 9th cl. (रीणाति) 1 To hurt, to injure. 2 To go, to move. 3 To howl, as a wild beast. (ङ) रीङ् r. 4th cl. (रीयते) 1 To distil, to ooze, to drop. 2 To fall, to alight. r. 2nd cl. (रेति) To bear or conceive, (as a child.)
रीज्या: रीज्या f. (-ज्या) 1 Reproach, censure. 2 Shame, modesty. E. ह्री to be ashamed, deriv. irr.
रीढक: रीढक m. (-कः) The backbone. E. रिह to hurt, aff. क्त, and the vowel made long, रीढ, कन् added.
रीढा: रीढा f. (-ढा) Disrespect, irreverence, disregard. E. रिह to kill, &c., aff. क्त, and the vowel made long.
रीण: रीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Oozing, dripping, leaking, distilling. E. री to leak, to run out, aff. क्त.
रीति: रीति f. (-तिः-ती) 1 Usage, custom, practice, local or traditionary observance. 2 Oozing, leaking, distilling. 3 Brass, pale brass, or prince's metal. 4 Rust of iron. 5 Calx of brass. 6 Scoria of any metal, or the oxide formed on the surface of metals by their exposure to heat and air. 7 Boundary, limit. 8 Going, motion. 9 Natural property or disposition. E. री to go, to run out, &c., aff. क्तिन्.
रीतिका: रीतिका f. (-का) Calx of brass. E. रीति brass, and कन् aff.
रीतिपुष्प: रीतिपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) Calx of brass. E. रीति brass, and पुष्प a flower.
रीव: रीव r. 1st cl. (रीवते) 1 To take. 2 To screen.
रु: रु (टु) टुरु r. 2nd cl. (रौति) To sound, to make a particular sort of sound. (ड,) रुङ् r. 1st cl. (रवते) 1 To go, to move. 2 To hurt, to injure or kill. 3 To speak. 4 To be angry.
रु m. (रुः) 1 War, battle. 2 Noise, sound. f. (रुः) 1 Fear, alarm. 2 Cutting, dividing. E. रु to sound, aff. क्विप्.
रुक्प्रतिक्रिया: रुक्प्रतिक्रिया f. (-या) The practice of physic, curing, remedying. E. रुक् from रुच् disease, प्रतिक्रिया resisting.
रुक्म: रुक्म n. (-क्मं) 1 Gold. 2 Iron. E. रुच to shine, Uṇādi aff. मक्.
रुक्मकारक: रुक्मकारक m. (-कः) A gold-smith. E. रुक्म gold, and कारक a worker.
रुक्मवत्: रुक्मवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Golden. f. (-वती) A species of the Paṅkti metre. E. रुक्म, and मतुप् aff.
रुक्मिदर्प: रुक्मिदर्प m. (-र्पः) A name of BALARĀMA. E. रुक्मिन् a king, and दर्प pride; proud of overcoming him.
रुक्मिदारिन्: रुक्मिदारिन् m. (-री) BALARĀMA. E. रुक्मिन् a prince, and दारिन् destroyer.
रुक्मिन्: रुक्मिन् m. (-क्मी) The name of a prince slain by BALARĀMA. f. (-क्मिणी) 1 The goddess LAKṢMĪ. E. 2 A princess carried off. and married by KṚṢṆA. E. रुक्म gold, and इनि poss. aff.
रुक्मिभिद्: रुक्मिभिद् m. (-भिद्) BALARĀMA. E. रुक्मि a prince, the elder brother of RUKMIṆĪ, and भिद् breaker, conqueror.
रुक्सद्मन्: रुक्सद्मन् n. (-द्म) Excrement, fæces. E. रुज् disease, सद्मन् abode.
रुक्ष: रुक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Harsh, unkind. 2 Rough, hard. 3 Rugged, uneven. E. रुह to grow, Uṇādi aff. स्; it is more properly written रूक्ष, as derived from रूक्ष to be rough.
रुग्न: रुग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) 1 Bent, crooked, curbed. 2 Broken. 3 Impaired, injured. 4 Diseased, sick, infirm. E. रुज to be disordered, aff. क्त.
रुग्नता: रुग्नता f. (-ता) 1 Sickness, disease. 2 Crookedness. E. रुग्न, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रुग्नत्वं.
रुच: रुच r. 1st cl. (रोचति) 1 To shine. 2 To please, to be pleased.
रुच्: रुच् f. (रुक्) 1 Light, lustre, splendour. 2 Beauty, loveliness. 3 Lightning. 4 Wish, desire. 5 The chattering of the parrot or Maina. 6 The Ṛg Veda. E. रुच् to shine, aff. क्विप्; also with टाप् added रुचा.
रुचक: रुचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Agreeable, pleasing. 2 Sharp, acrid. 3 Tonic, stomachic. m. (-कः) 1 The citron, (Citrus medica.) 2 An ornament of the neck or breast. 3 A tooth. 4 A pigeon. n. (-कं) 1 Salt. 2 Natron, alkali. 3 Borax. 4 A garland, a chaplet. 5 A curl on a horse's neck. 6 The woody Cassia. 7 Any auspicious or fortunate object. 8 A perfume, commonly Rocanā. 9 An anthelmintic medicine, commonly Virenga, (Embelia ribes?) 10 A sort of temple. 11 A stomachic. E. रुच to shine, &c. in the causal form, क्वुन् aff.; the embellisher, the polisher, &c.
रुचि: रुचि f. (-चिः-ची) 1 Light, lustre. 2 Beauty. 3 Passion. 4 Wish, desire. 5 A ray of light. 6 Intent application to any object or undertaking. 7 Hunger, appetite. 8 Taste, sentiment. E. रुच् to shine, कि aff.
रुचिकर: रुचिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Beautifying. 2 Sharpening, as the appetite, &c. E. रुचि, and कर what makes.
रुचित: रुचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sweet. 2 Sharpened, (as the appetite.) 3 Digested. 4 Bright, brightened. f. (-ता) Species of the Atijagatī metre. E. रुच to please, Uṇādi aff. कितच्.
रुचिर: रुचिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Beautiful, charming, pleasing. 2 Sweet. 3 Stomachic, restorative. E. रुच to please, Uṇādi aff. किरच्.
रुचिरमुद्: रुचिरमुद् mfn. (-द्) Exquisite, affording great pleasure. E. रुचिर, and मुद what delights.
रुचिरानन: रुचिरानन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Handsome, beautiful. E. रुचिर, and आनन face.
रुचिरापाङ्गी: रुचिरापाङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A beautiful charming woman. E. रुचिर, and अपाङ्ग corner of the eye.
रुचिष्य: रुचिष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) 1 Sweet. 2 Stomachic. E. रुच to be agreeable, Uṇādi aff. किष्यन्.
रुच्य: रुच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) 1 Beautiful, pleasing. 2 Stomachic, tonic. m. (-च्यः) A husband, a lover. n. (-च्यं) A digestive, a tonic. E. रुच to please, aff. क्यप्.
रुज: रुज (औ ओ) औरुजो r. 6th cl. (रुजति) 1 To afflict, to disorder, to afflict with pain or disease. 2 To bend or break. r. 10th cl. (रोजयति) To hurt, to injure.
रुज्: रुज् f. (रुक्) Sickness, disease. E. रुज् to be or make sick, aff. क्विप्; also with टाप् added रुजा.
रुजत्: रुजत् mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्) 1 Breaking. 2 Giving pain, making ill or sick. 2 Being sick. E. रुज to afflict. शतृ aff.
रुजा: रुजा f. (-जा) 1 Sickness, disease. 2 Overthrow, destruction. 3 An ewe. E. रुज to be or make sick, aff. क and टाप्.
रुजाकर: रुजाकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Sickening, making sick or ill. m. (-रः) One of the Bhāvas or sentiments, the sickness induced by passion or love. n. (-रं) An acid fruit, (the fruit of the Averrhoa carambola.) E. रुजा sickness, कर what makes.
रुट: रुट r. 1st cl. (रोटते) 1 To resist or oppose. 2 To strive again. 3 To tumble or roll for passion. r. 10th cl. (रोटयति) 1 To be angry. 2 To shine. (इ) रुटि r. 1st cl. (रुण्ठति) To steal, to rob.
रुठ: रुठ r. 1st cl. (रोठति) To strike, to fell, to knock down, to overturn. (रोठते) To resist, to oppose. (इ) रुठि r. 1st cl. (रुण्ठति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To steal. 3 To be idle. 4 To be lame.
रुणस्करा: रुणस्करा f. (-रा) A cow easily milked.
रुण्ड: रुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A headless body, retaining life and mixing in combat. E. रुडि for रुटि or रुठि to take or steal, aff. अच्.
रुण्डिका: रुण्डिका f. (-का) 1 The threshold of a door. 2 A field of battle. 3 A female messenger or go-between. 4 Superhuman power. E. रुण्ड as above, कन् aff., fem. form.
रुत: रुत n. (-तं) 1 The cry of birds, &c. 2 Any cry or noise. E. रु to sound, to make a particular sound, aff. क्त.
रुतव्याज: रुतव्याज m. (-जः) 1 Mimicry. 2 Simulated cry or sound. E. रुत, and व्याज disguise.
रुतायत: रुतायत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rendered vocal by the cry of birds, &c. E. रुत cry, used as a verb, क्त aff.
रुद: रुद(इर)रुदिर r. 2nd cl. (रोदिति) 1 To weep. 2 To call or address weeping. With उप and आङ्, To weep for another, to sympathize.
रुद्: रुद् f. (रुत्) 1 Grief. 2 Pain, affliction. 3 Disease. 4 Sound, noise. 5 Cry, wail, lamentation. E. रुद to weep, aff. क्विप्.
रुदत्: रुदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दती-दत्) Weeping, wailing. E. रुद to weep, शतृ aff.
रुदथ: रुदथ m. (-थः) 1 A dog. 2 A pupil, a scholar. E. रुद to weep, अथन् Uṇādi aff.
रुदित: रुदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Crying, weeping, wept, (by whom.) n. (-तं) Weeping. E. रुद to weep, aff. क्त.
रुद्ध: रुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Surrounded, begirt, as with a fence or river, &c. 2 Secured, protected from access. 3 Obstructed, stopped, shut up. 4 Opposed, stopped, impeded. 5 Besieged, invested, blockaded. f. (-द्धा) A siege. E. रुध to close, &c., aff. क्त.
रुद्यमान: रुद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being weeping or wailing. E. रुद to weep, pass. v., शानच् aff.
रुद्र: रुद्र m. (-द्रः) 1 A name or form of ŚIVA. 2 A demi-god, an inferior manifestation of ŚIVA, or according to one legend, a being born from the forehead of BRAHMĀ: the RUDRAS are eleven in number, and are severally named, AJAIKAPĀDA, AHIVRADHNA, VIRŪPĀKṢA, SUREŚVARA, JAYANTA, BAHURŪPA, TRYAMBAKA, APARĀJITA, SAVITRA, and HARA. f. (-द्री) A sort of lute or guitar. E. रुद to weep, रक् Uṇādi aff., and the vowel unchanged; the name is given to ŚIVA, because according to his own declaration, he disperses the tears of  mortals: to the demi-gods, because they wept at their birth, or because they made the enemies of the gods weep.
रुद्रज: रुद्रज n. (-जं) Quicksilver. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, and ज born, being supposed to be the semen of the deity.
रुद्रपत्नी: रुद्रपत्नी f. (-त्नी) 1 Linseed, (Linum.) 2 The goddess DURGĀ. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, and पत्नी wife.
रुद्रप्रिया: रुद्रप्रिया f. (-या) 1 Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica) 2 The goddess PĀRVATĪ. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, &c., and प्रिया the beloved.
रुद्रभू: रुद्रभू f. (-भूः) A cemetery. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, and भू site or haunt.
रुद्रबलि: रुद्रबलि m. (-लिः) Oblations of meat, &c. presented to the RUDRAS. E. रुद्र a RUDRA, and बलि sacrifice.
रुद्रसू: रुद्रसू f. (-सूः) The mother of eleven children. E. रुद्र a RUDRA, of whom there are eleven, and सू mother.
रुद्राक्रीड: रुद्राक्रीड m. (-डः) A cemetery, a place where dead bodies are burnt or buried. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, and आक्रीड place of sport; being supposed to dance and sport in such places at evening twilight.
रुद्राक्ष: रुद्राक्ष m. (-क्षः) A tree, (Eleocarpus ganitrus, Rox.) n. (-क्षं) The berry of the Eleocarpus, of which rosaries are usually made. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, and अक्ष from अक्षि the eye.
रुद्राणी: रुद्राणी f. (-णी) The goddess DURGĀ, as the wife of RUDRA or ŚIVA. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, ङीष् aff., and आनुक् augment.
रुद्रावास: रुद्रावास n. (-सः) Benares. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, and आवास abode.
रुद्रारि: रुद्रारि m. (-रिः) KĀMA, the deity of love. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, and अरि enemy.
रुध: रुध r. 4th cl. (with अनु prefixed) (अनुरुध्यते) 1 To desire, to wish for, to love. 2 To be kind to. 3 To consent, to concur. 4 To lament or be sorry for. (ञि औ इर) ञि औरुधिर् r. 7th cl. (रुणद्धि रुंद्धे) 1 To impede, to oppose, to obstruct, to block or confine. 2 To invest, to blockade, to besiege. With अभि and सम् prefixed, To prevent. With अव, To guard. With उप, To blockade. With प्रति or वि, To oppose, to resist. With सम् and नि, To shut up, to surround or blockade.
रुधिर: रुधिर n. (-रं) 1 Blood. 2 Saffron. m. (-रः) The planet MARS. E. रुध to obstruct, किरच् Uṇādi aff.
रुधिरपायिन्: रुधिरपायिन् m. (-यी) A Rākṣasa, a demon. E. रुधिर, and पायिन् who drinks.
रुध्वा: रुध्वा ind. Having stopped, checked, impeded, &c. E. रुध to hinder. क्त्वाच् aff.
रुन्धत्: रुन्धत् mfn. (-न्धन्-न्धती-न्धत्) 1 Hindering, opposing, stopping. 2 Resisting, refusing. E. रुध to hinder, शतृ aff.
रुप: रुप r. 4th cl. (रुप्यति) To confound, to perplex, to confuse.
रुमा: रुमा f. (-मा) 1 The wife of the monkey SUGRĪVA. 2 The district, or more properly the salt mines of Sambhar, a town in Ajmer, twenty miles west of Jayanagar. E. रु to weep, मन् aff., with टाप् fem. aff., deriv. irr.
रुम्र: रुम्र m. (-म्रः) ARUṆA, or the dawn. E. रम to sport, Uṇādi aff. रव्, and रु substituted for the initial.
रुरु: रुरु m. (-रुः) 1 A sort of deer. 2 A Daitya flayed by ŚIVA. E. रु to weep, कु aff.
रुरुत्सु: रुरुत्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु). 1 Wishing to oppose or obstruct. 2 Wishing to bind or tie up, (as the hair.) E. रुध to oppose, desid. v., उ aff.
रुरुदिषु: रुरुदिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing or purposing to wail or weep, ready to cry. E. रुद to weep, desid. v., उ aff.
रुवत्: रुवत् mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्) Crying, calling, howling. E. रु to cry, शतृ aff.
रुवथु: रुवथु m. (-थुः) 1 Sound, noise. 2 A cock.
रुवु: रुवु m. (-वुः) The castor-oil tree, (Ricinus communis.) E. रु to weep, कु aff., and the final vowel changed to उव; also with कन् added रुवुक, and with the first or second vowel made long, रुवुक and रुवूक; also, as differently derived, उरुवूक.
रुश: रुश r. 6th cl. (रुशति) To hurt or kill. (इ) रुशि r. 10th cl. (रुंशयति) To shine.
रुशत्: रुशत् mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्) 1 Maledictory, imprecative. 2 Cursing, imprecating. E. रुश to seek to injure, aff. शतृ.
रुष: रुष r. 1st cl. (रोषति) 4th cl. (रुष्यति) To hurt, to injure, to kill or attempt to kill. (इर्) रुषिर r. 4th and 10th cls. (रुष्यति रोषयति) To be angry, to be passionate or wrathful.
रुष्: रुष् f. (रुट्) Anger, wrath, passion. E. रुष to be angry, aff. क्विप्; also with टाप् added रुषा f. (-षा)
रुषित: रुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Enraged, angry. E. रुष to be angry, aff. क्त with इट् augment.
रुष्ट: रुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Angry, enraged. E. रुष to be angry, aff. क्त.
रुष्टि: रुष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Wrath, rage, anger. E. रुष to be angry, क्तिन् aff.
रुह: रुह(ञि औ) ञिऔरुह r. 1st cl. (रोहति) 1 To grow from seed, to grow as a tree, &c. 2 To be produced or become manifest. 3 To be born. With अधि prefixed, To go up or over, to ascend. With अधि and आङ्, To ascend. With अव, To descend. With आङ्. 1 To mount, to ride on. 2 To rise, to ascend. With प्र, To grow, to shoot forth as a branch or shoot taking fresh root.
रुह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Growing, springing up. 2 Mounted, ascended. E. रुह to grow, aff. क.
रुहक: रुहक n. (-कं) A hole, a vacuity, a cave, a chasm. E. रुह to go or mount, (insects, &c.,) and क्वुन् aff.
रुहा: रुहा f. (-हा) Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon.) E. रुह to grow, affs. क and टाप्.
रुह्वन्: रुह्वन् m. (-ह्वा) A tree. E. रुह to grow, Uṇādi aff. क्वनिप्.
रूक्ष: रूक्ष r. 10th cl. (रूक्षयति) To be harsh.

रूक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Harsh, rough, not smooth or soft. 2 Rough to the taste, astringent, austere, not bland or sapid. 3 Rugged, uneven. 4 Harsh, unkind, unfriendly. m. (-क्षः) A tree in general. E. रूक्ष to be harsh or rough, aff. क.
रूक्षता: रूक्षता f. (-ता) 1 Roughness. 2 Harshness. E. रुक्ष, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रूक्षत्वं.
रूढ: रूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Born, produced. 2 Famous, notorious. 3 Certain, ascertained. 4 Budded, blown. 5 Much, exceeding. 6 Increased, grown. 7 Traditional, conventional, or known, applied especially to words of foreign or unknown origin, but of which the employment and application are familiar. E. रुह to be born, &c., and क्त aff.
रूढि: रूढि f. (-ढिः) 1 Birth, production. 2 Growing, growth. 3 Fame, notoriety. 4 Traditional or customary meaning of words, as opposed to their etymological signification; it is especially applied to words of foreign or uncertain origin, and incapable of etymological analysis. E. रुह to grow, &c., aff. क्तिन्.
रूढिशब्द: रूढिशब्द m. (-ब्दः) A word used in a peculiar but familiar sense. E. रूढि, and शब्द noun.
रूप: रूप r. 10th cl. (रूपयति) To form, to express form, to represent shape either to the eye or the understanding. With नि prefixed, 1 To discuss, to investigate. 2 To explain, to describe, to declare, to expound.

रूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Like, resembling, (in composition, as पितृरूपः पुत्त्रः a son like his father.) n. (-पं) 1 Natural property or disposition nature. 2 Beauty. 3 Form, figure. 4 Appearance, semblance. 5 Cattle generally, flocks and herds, &c. 6 A verse. 7 Declension, conjugation, the inflection of nouns or verbs. 8 A play, a dramatic poem. 9 Acquiring familiarity with any book or authority by frequent perusal, learning by heart or rote. 10 An image, a figure, a reflection or resemblance of any real object. 11 Colour, form, any object of vision. 12 (In arithmetic,) Discrete or distinct quantity, an entire number. 13 Known quantity, whence the first syllable Rū is used in algebra to express the same. E. रूप to express form, aff. क, or रु to sound, Uṇādi aff. प, and the radical vowel made long.
रूपक: रूपक n. (-कं) 1 A drama, a dramatic poem. 2 Shape, form, figure. 3 A figure of rhetoric in general. 4 A particular class of rhetorical or poetical figures, including various modes of poetical description, or the illustration and exhibition of visible things and persons. 5 Identification of the objects of a comparison; their being not only like, but the very same. 6 Symptom of disease. f. (-पिका) Swallow wort. E. रूप form, figure, aff. कन्.
रूपतत्त्व: रूपतत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) Natural or inherent disposition or property, nature. E. रूप form, and तत्त्व truth, essence.
रूपधृत्: रूपधृत् mfn. (-धृत्) Having the form, resembling, like. E. रूप, and धृ to have, क्विप् aff., and तुक् added.
रूपनाशन: रूपनाशन m. (-नः) An owl. E. रूप form, and नाशन destroying.
रूपभृत्: रूपभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) Having form or beauty. E. रूप, and भृ to possess, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् added.
रूपयत्: रूपयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Describing, representing. E. रूप to form, शतृ aff.
रूपलावण्य: रूपलावण्य n. (-ण्यं) Elegance, loveliness. E. रूप, and लावण्य beauty.
रूपवत्: रूपवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Having shape or colour, &c. 2 Well-shaped, beautiful, handsome. E. रूप form, &c., and मतुप् poss. aff.
रूपसम्पट्: रूपसम्पट् f. (-त् or -ट्) Beauty. E. रूप, and सम्पट् fortune.
रूपाजीवा: रूपाजीवा f. (-वा) A whore, a harlot. E. रूप beauty, and आजीव who lives by.
रूपाधिबोध: रूपाधिबोध m. (-धः) The perception, evidence, or influence of the senses, i. e. of colour, sound, odour, flavour, and contact. E. रूप, and अधिबोध perception.
रूपास्त्र: रूपास्त्र m. (-स्त्रः) KĀMADEVA. E. रूप beauty, and अस्त्र a weapon.
रूपिन्: रूपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि) 1 Beautiful, having a handsome form or shape. 2 Having form or shape. E. रूप, and इनि aff.
रूप्य: रूप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Handsome, beautiful. n. (-प्यं) 1 Silver. 2 Wrought silver. 3 Wrought gold. E. रूप form, colour, &c., and यत् aff.
रूप्याध्यक्ष: रूप्याध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) The master of the mint, the superintendant of the silver, or silver coinage. E. रूप्य silver, and अध्यक्ष superintendant.
रूवुक: रूवुक m. (-कः) The castor oil tree, (Ricinus communis:) see रूवु; also रूवूक, and रुवुक, &c.
रूष: रूष r. 1st cl. (रूषति) To decorate, to adorn.
रूषक: रूषक m. (-कः) A plant, (Justicia ganderussa.) E. रूष to adorn, aff. क्वुन्.
रूषित: रूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pounded, reduced to dust or powder. 2 Covered, spread over, coated, inlaid. 3 Adorned, decorated. 4 Made rough or rugged. E. रूष to adorn, aff. क्त.
रे: रे A vocative particle, but expressive of contempt or disrespect.
रेक: रेक(ऋ,)रेकृ r. 1st cl. (रेकते) 1 To suspect or think probable. 2 To excite or entertain doubt: in the last case with आङ् usually prefixed.
रेक mf. (-कः-का) 1 Doubt, uncertainty. 2 Fear, apprehension. m. (-कः) 1 Looseness, purging. 2 An outcaste, a low man. 3 A frog. E. रेक to suspect, to fear, aff. अच्, or रिच to purge, aff. घञ्.
रेकणस्: रेकणस् n. (-णः) Gold. E. रिच to divide, Uṇādi aff. असुन्, नुट् augment, and च changed to क.
रेखा: रेखा f. (-खा) 1 A line, a continuous line. 2 Deceit, fraud. 3 A little. 4 Fulness, satisfaction. E. see लेखा, the initial being changed to र.
रेचक: रेचक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Purgative, aperient. m. (-कः) 1 A cathartic, a purgative. 2 Nitre, saltpetre. 3 The purging-nut plant, (Croton tiglium.) n. (-कं) A purge. E. रिच् to evacuate by stool, causal form, वुन् aff.
रेचन: रेचन nf. (-नं-ना) Purging, looseness. f. (-ना-नी) A drug, commonly Śuṇḍārocanī. f. (-नी) 1 A plant, Tëori, (Convolvulus turpethum,) the white sort. 2 Another plant, commonly Danti, (Croton polyandrum.) E. रिच to purge, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.
रेचित: रेचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Left void or empty, freed from, cleared. 2 Purged. E. रिच to purge, क्त aff.
रेज: रेज(ऋ,)रेजृ r. 1st cl. (रेजते) To shine: this root is not universally admitted.
रेज्: रेज् m. (रेट्) AGNI or fire. E. रेज् to shine, aff. क्विप्.
रेट: रेट(ऋ)रेदृ r. 1st cl. (रेटति-ते) 1 To speak. 2 To ask or beg.
रेणु: रेणु mf. (-णुः-णु) Dust. m. (-णुः) A medicinal plant, commonly Pāpar. E. रि to hurt, Uṇādi aff. नु.
रेणुका: रेणुका f. (-का) A sort of perfume and medicine, of a bitter and slightly pungent taste, and greyish colour; it is procured in grains about the size of those of pepper. 2 The wife of the saint JAMADAGNI and mother of PARAŚURĀMA. 3 A sort of pulse, (Ervum or Cicer lens.) E. रेणु sand, dust, and कन् added.
रेणुकासुत: रेणुकासुत m. (-तः) PARAŚURĀMA. E. रेणुका the mother of the hero, and सुत son.
रेणुरूषित: रेणुरूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dusty, covered over with dust. m. (-तः) An ass. E. रेणु dust, and रूषित made rough.
रेणुवास: रेणुवास m. (-सः) A bee. E. रेणु dust (the pollen of flower), and वास abode.
रेणुसार: रेणुसार m. (-रः) Camphor. E. रेण dust, and सार essence; also with कन् added रेणुसारक.
रेतस्: रेतस् n. (-तः) 1 The seminal fluid. 2 Quicksilver. E. री to ooze, Uṇādi aff. असुन्, and तुट् augment.
रेत्य: रेत्य n. (-त्यं) Calx of brass. E. री to go, यत् aff., and तुट् augment.
रेत्र: रेत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 Semen virile. 2 Quicksilver. 3 Nectar or ambrosia. 4 Perfumed or aromatic powder, pulvilio. E. री to flow, ष्ट्रन् aff., and तुट् augment.
रेप: रेप(ऋ)रेपृ r. 1st cl. (रेपति-ते) 1 To go, to move. 2 To sound.
रेप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) 1 Low, vile, inferior, contemptible. 2 Cruel, savage. E. रि to injure, प aff.
रेपस्: रेपस् mfn. (-पाः-पाः-पः) 1 Low, vile, contemptible. 2 Cruel, savage. 3 Miserly, niggardly, a miser. 4 Wicked, abandoned. E. रप to speak, to revile, Uṇādi aff. असुन्, and ए substituted for the radical vowel.
रेफ: रेफ mfn. (-फः-फा-फं) 1 Low, vile, contemptible, wicked. 2 Defamed, reviled. m. (-फः) 1 The letter R. 2 Passion, affection of the mind. E. र the letter R. with the inherent short vowel, and इफ aff.; or रिफ् to defame, to reproach, aff. घञ्.
रेफस्: रेफस् mfn. (-फाः-फाः-फः) 1 Low, vile, contemptible. 2 Wicked, abandoned. 3 Miserly, a niggard. 4 Cruel, savage. E. रिफ् to reproach, aff. असुन्; also रेफ, रेपस्, and रेप.
रेब: रेब(ऋ)रेबृ r. 1st cl. (रेबते) To go, to move.
रेभण: रेभण n. (-णं) The lowing of kine. E. रेभ to sound, aff. ल्युट्.
रेरिहाण: रेरिहाण m. (-णः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 An Asura; an evil spirit. 3 A thief.
रेव: रेव(ऋ)रेवृ (रेवते) 1 To go by leaps or jumps, to leap, to jump. 2 To go, to move. 3 To flow as a river.
रेवट: रेवट n. (-टं) A conch shell with sinistral convolutions, or the spiral lines turning from the right to the left. m. (-टः) 1 Oil of the Morunga tree. 2 A plantain, the fruit. 3 A hog. 4 Dust. 5 A whirlwind. 6 A conjuror, a juggler, a snake dancer. E. रेव to go, अटन् aff.
रेवत: रेवत m. (-तः) A prince, the father of the wife of BALARĀMA.
रेवति: रेवति f. (-तिः) The wife of KĀMA.
रेवती: रेवती f. (-ती) 1 The wife of BALARĀMA, the brother of KṚṢṆA. 2 The last of the Nakṣatras or lunar asterisms, containing thirty two stars, figured by a tabor; one of the stars is ζ piscium. 3 One of the Mātṛs or energies of the gods. 4 A cow. E. रेवत the name of a king, the father of BALARĀMA'S wife, and ङीष् aff.
रेवतीभव: रेवतीभव m. (-वः) The planet SATURN. E. रेवती the nymph or asterism personified, and भव born.
रेवतीरमण: रेवतीरमण m. (-णः) BALARĀMA. E. रेवती the wife of BALARĀMA, and रमण husband.
रेवतीश: रेवतीश m. (-शः) BALARĀMA. E. रेवत the wife of this demigod, and ईश lord or husband.
रेवन्त: रेवन्त m. (-न्तः) The fifth MANU of the present Kalpa; also called RAIVATA.
रेवन्तमनुसू: रेवन्तमनुसू f. (-सूः) SAṂJÑĀ, wife of the sun. E. रेवन्त Revanta, मनु the MANU, and सू the mother.
रेवा: रेवा f. (-वा) 1 The Nerbadda, or Narmadā river, which rises in the mountain Āmrakūṭa, or Amerkantak, in the province of Gondvāna, and runs nearly due west about 750 miles, when it falls into the sea below Baroach. 2 RATI, the wife of KĀMA. 3 The indigo plant. E. रेव to flow, aff. अच्.
रेष: रेष(ऋ)रेषृ r. 1st cl. (रेषते) 1 To utter an inarticulate sound. 2 To neigh. 3 To howl.
रेष्: रेष् mfn. (रेट्) Who or what neighs, howls, &c. E. रेष to neigh, विच् aff.
रेषण: रेषण n. (-णं) Howling, roaring. E. रेष to sound inarticulately, aff. ल्युट्; also with अङ् and टाप्, aff. रेषा.
रेषित: रेषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sounded, made as a noise. n. (-तं) Neighing, roaring. E. रेष to sound, aff. क्त.
रेष्टृ: रेष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) An injurer. E. रिष to hurt, तृच् aff.
रै: रै m. (-राः) 1 Wealth, property, substance. 2 Gold. 3 Sound, noise. E. रा to give, Uṇādi aff. डै.
रैत्य: रैत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्यी-त्यं) Brazen, made of brass. E. रीति, and यञ् aff.
रैवत: रैवत m. (-तः) 1 A mountain, the eastern part of the Vindhya range, or that part in which the Revā rises. 2 A tree, (Cassia fistula.) 3 A name of ŚIVA. 4 A Daitya or demon. 5 The fifth MANU of the present Kalpa. E. रेवा the Revā river, aff. अञ्, and त added.
रैवतक: रैवतक m. (-कः) The mountain Raivata. E. कन् added to the preceding; also with ठक् added to रेवत, रैवतिक.
रोक: रोक n. (-कं) 1 A hole, a chasm, a vacuity. 2 A boat. 3 Moving, shaking. m. (-कः) 1 Buying with ready money. 2 Light. E. रुच to shine, aff. घञ्.
रोग: रोग m. (-गः) 1 Sickness, disease in general, or a disease. 2 A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.) E. रुज to be or make sick, aff. घञ्.
रोगग्रस्त: रोगग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Sick, diseased. E. रोग, and ग्रस्त seized.
रोगघ्न: रोगघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Curative, medical. E. रोग, and घ्न what destroys.
रोगभू: रोगभू f. (-भूः) The body. E. रोग disease, and भू the soil.
रोगराज: रोगराज m. (-जः) Consumption. E. रोग disease, and राज principal.
रोगलक्षण: रोगलक्षण n. (-णं) The symptoms or sign of a disease, or of its progress. E. रोग a disease, and लक्षण mark.
रोगशान्तक: रोगशान्तक m. (-कः) A physician. E. रोग disease, and शान्तक alleviator.
रोगशान्ति: रोगशान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Cure or alleviation of disease. E. रोग, and शान्ति appeasing; also रोगशमः and the like.
रोगशिल्पिन्: रोगशिल्पिन् m. (-ल्पी) A tree, (Cassia fistula.) E. रोग disease, and शिल्पिन् an artisan.
रोगह: रोगह n. (-हं) A drug, a medicament. E. रोग disease, हा to abandon, aff. क.
रोगहन्: रोगहन् m. (-हा) A physician. E. रोग, and हन to destroy, क्विप् aff.
रोगहर: रोगहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Curative, medicinal. E. रोग, and हर what takes.
रोगहारिन्: रोगहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Curative, medicinal. m. (-री) A physician. E. रोग disease, हृ to remove, to take away, णिनि aff.
रोगान्तक: रोगान्तक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Curative, medicinal. m. (-कः) A physician. E. रोग, and अन्तक destroyer.
रोगान्वित: रोगान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sick, diseased. E. रोग, and अन्वित having.
रोगार्त: रोगार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Suffering pain or sickness. E. रोग, and आर्त्त pained.
रोगार्त्त: रोगार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Suffering pain or sickness. E. रोग, and आर्त्त pained.
रोगिता: रोगिता f. (-ता) Sickness, disease. E. रोगिन्, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रोगित्वं.
रोगिन्: रोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Diseased, ill, sick, affected with sickness or disease. E. रोग disease, and इनि aff.
रोगिवल्लभ: रोगिवल्लभ n. (-भं) A drug, a medicament. E. रोगि a sick man, and वल्लभ the friend.
रोगोपशम: रोगोपशम m. (-मः) Cure or alleviation of disease. E. रोग, and उपशम allaying.
रोग्य: रोग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) 1 Counter-indicated, as menstrua or regimen, &c., what is improper to be taken in any disease or with the medicines administered. 2 Related to or connected with disease. E. रोग sickness, and यत् aff.
रोचक: रोचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) What pleases, brightens, strengthens, &c. m. (-कः) 1 Hunger, appetite. 2 The plantain. 3 A sort of onion. 4 A stomachic, a carminative, any medicine, fruit or fossil, supposed to strengthen the tone of the stomach and restore lost appetite. E. रुच to shine, &c., and ण्वुल् aff.
रोचन: रोचन mfn. (-नः-ना or -नी-नं) 1 Splendid, beautiful. 2 Irradiating, illumining, beautifying. 3 Gratifying, pleasing. 4 Whetting, sharpening, (the appetite.) m. (-नः) 1 A species of the silk-cotton tree. 2 The onion. 3 A tree, (Andersonia Rohitaca.) 4 The Cassia fistula. 5 The pomegranate. 6 The citron. 7 A stomachic, a carminative. f. (-नी) 1 A yellow pigment, commonly Gorocanā, and supposed to be the concrete bile of the cow, or according to some authorities, to be found in the head of the animal, used as a medicine, a dye, and perfume. 2 The manna of bambus. 3 A excellent woman. 4 A red lotus. f. (-ना-नी) 1 A plant, commonly Śuṇḍārocanī, a sort of Crinum? f. (-नी) 1 A variety of Tëori, (Convolvulus turpethum.) 2 Red arsenic. E. रुच to shine, ल्युट् or युच् aff.
रोचनिका: रोचनिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Śuṇḍārocanī. E. कन् added to रोचनी the same.
रोचमान: रोचमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Splendid, shining. 2 Pleasing, gratifying. m. (-नः) A tuft or curl of hair round the neck of a horse or on the lower part of it. E. रुच to shine, aff. शानच्.
रोचिष्णु: रोचिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Elegantly dressed or ornamented. 2 Splendid, brilliant. E. रुच to shine, इष्णुच् aff.
रोचिस्: रोचिस् n. (-चिः) Light. E. रुच to shine, इसुन् aff.
रोच्य: रोच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) To be illuminated or enlightened. E. रुच to shine, aff. ण्य.
रोड: रोड(ऋ)रोडृ r. 1st cl. (रोडति) 1 To be mad. 2 To disrespect.
रोदन: रोदन n. (-नं) 1 Weeping, crying. 2 A tear, tears. f. (-नी) A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) E. रुद to weep, aff. ल्युट्.
रोदस्: रोदस् n. (-दः) 1 Heaven. 2 Earth. dual. (-सी) Heaven and earth. E. रुद to weep, aff. असुन्.
रोदसी: रोदसी f. (-सी). 1 Heaven, paradise. 2 Earth. f. dual. (-स्यौ) Heaven and earth. E. ङीप् added to the preceding.
रोध: रोध m. (-धः) A bank, a shore. E. रुध to obstruct, aff. घञ्.
रोधन: रोधन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Impeding, that which impedes or obstructs, an obstacle, a hinderer or hindrance. m. (-नः) The planet MERCURY. n. (-नं) 1 Impeding, obstructing. 2 Besieging, blockading. E. रुध to obstruct, aff. ल्युट्.
रोधवक्रा: रोधवक्रा f. (-क्रा) A river. E. रोध a bank, and वक्र the course of a stream, fem. form.
रोधस्: रोधस् n. (-धः) A bank, a shore. E. रुध to obstruct, and असुन् aff.
रोधोवक्रा: रोधोवक्रा f. (-क्रा) A river. E. रोधस् a bank, and वक्र winding course.
रोध्र: रोध्र m. (-ध्रः) A tree, commonly Lodh. n. (-घ्रं) 1 Offence, transgression. 2 Sin. E. रुध to obstruct, and रन् aff.
रोप: रोप m. (-पः) 1 An arrow. 2 Confusing, disturbing, (the ideas.) n. (-पं) A hole, a vacuity, a chasm. E. रुप to disturb, aff. घञ्.
रोपक: रोपक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what plants, raises, &c. m. (-कः) A weight of metal or a coin, the seventieth part of a Suvarṇa. E. रुह to rise, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.
रोपण: रोपण n. (-णं) 1 Placing in or upon. 2 Planting. 3 Raising. 4 A disturbing or bewildering of the mind, a confusing, or confusion of ideas. 4 Cicatrizing, healing. 5 A healing application to sores or wounds. E. रुह to ascend, causal v., or रुप to bewilder, aff. ल्युट्.
रोपित: रोपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Placed in or upon. 2 Planted. 3 Raised, elevated. Bewildered, perplexed. E. रुह to rise, causal v., or रुप to bewilder, क्त aff.
रोम: रोम n. (-मं) Water. m. (-मः) A hole.
रोमकर्णक: रोमकर्णक m. (-कः) A hare. E. रोम hair, and कर्ण the ear, कन् added.
रोमकूप: रोमकूप m. (-पः) A pore of the skin. E. रोम hair, and कूप a well, a pit.
रोमकेशर: रोमकेशर n. (-रं) A Chowri. E. रोम hair of an animal, (especially of the Yac,) and केशर a filament.
रोमगुच्छ: रोमगुच्छ n. (-च्छं) A Chowri, a sort of whisk. E. रोम hair, (see the last word,) and गुच्छ a cluster; also with कन् added, रोमगुच्छक.
रोमन्: रोमन् n. (-म) The hair of the body. E. रु to make, Uṇādi aff. मनिन्, form irr.
रोमन्थ: रोमन्थ n. (-न्थं) Ruminating, chewing the cud, or also eating, without chewing what has been once swallowed and again brought into the mouth. E. रोग disease, and मन्थ to destroy or remove, aff. अच्, deriv. irr.; this habit in animals being indispensable to digestion and health.
रोमबद्ध: रोमबद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Made of or fastened with the hair of animals, (as horse hair, &c.) E. रोम, and बद्ध bound.
रोमभूमि: रोमभूमि f. (-मिः) The skin. E. रोम the hair, and भूमि soil, site.
रोमलता: रोमलता f. (-ता) A line of hair extending to the navel. E. रोम hair, and लता a creeper.
रोमवत्: रोमवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Hairy, woolly. E. रोम hair of the body, and मतुप् aff.
रोमविकार: रोमविकार m. (-रः) Horripilation. E. रोम the hair of the body, and विकार change of state.
रोमविक्रिया: रोमविक्रिया f. (-या) Horripilation. E. रोम the hair, and विक्रिया change.
रोमविध्वंश: रोमविध्वंश m. (-शः) A body louse. E. रोम, and विध्वंश loss.
रोमश: रोमश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Hairy, woolly. m. (-शः) 1 A ram, a sheep. 2 A hog. E. रोमन् hair, and श aff.
रोमहर्ष: रोमहर्ष m. (-र्षः) Horripilation. E. रोम the hair of the body, and हर्ष pleasure.
रोमहर्षण: रोमहर्षण n. (-णं) Horripilation, erection or rigidity of the hair of the body, conceived to be occasioned by and to express exquisite delight. m. (-णः) 1 SŪTA, the pupil of VYĀSA, and supposed narrator of the events recorded in the Purāṇas. 2 Beleric myrobalan. E. रोम the hair, and हर्ष्ण delighting.
रोमाञ्च: रोमाञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) Horripilation, rigidity and erection of the hair of the body. E. रोम the hair, अञ्च to worship, aff. घञ्.
रोमाञ्चित: रोमाञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having the hair of the body erect, considered as a proof of exquisite pleasure; enraptured, delighted. E. रोमाञ्च horripilation, इतच् aff.
रोमाली: रोमाली f. (-ली) A line of hair, extending across the navel. E. रोमन् hair, and आली a line.
रोमावली: रोमावली f. (-ली) A line of hair across the middle of the belly or navel. E. रोम, and आवली a line.
रोमोद्गम: रोमोद्गम m. (मः) Horripilation. E. रोम hair, उद्गम rising; also रोमोद्ग m. (-द्गः).
रोमोद्भेद: रोमोद्भेद m. (-दः) Horripilation. E. रोम hair of the body, and उद्भेद breaking forth, protrusion.
रोरुदा: रोरुदा f. (-दा) Violent weeping. E. रुद to weep, frequent. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
रोरुदावत्: रोरुदावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Weeping or wailing violently. E. रोरुदा, and मतुप् aff.
रोरुद्यमान: रोरुद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Crying bitterly. E. रुद to weep, frequent. v., शानच् aff.
रोल: रोल m. (-लः) 1 A fruit, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) 2 Moist ginger.
रोलम्ब: रोलम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) Distrustful, unbelieving. m. (-म्बः) 1 A bee. 2 Dry or arid soil. E. रोड to be mad, अम्बच् aff., and ड changed to ल.
रोष: रोष m. (-पः) Anger, wrath. E. रुष to be angry, aff. घञ्.
रोषण: रोषण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Angry, passionate. m. (-णं) 1 Quicksilver. 2 A touchstone. 3 Arid or desart soil. E. रुष to be angry, aff. युच्.
रोषवाहण: रोषवाहण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Angry, feeling and displaying wrath. E. रोष, and वह to bear, causal v., युच् aff.
रोष्टृ: रोष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Violent, wrathful, angry. E. रुष to be angry, तृच् aff.
रोह: रोह m. (-हः) 1 A bud, a blossom. 2 Mounting, ascending. E. रुह to grow, aff. घञ्.
रोहक: रोहक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A rider, riding, mounted, one who rides on any animal or is carried in any vehicle. m. (-कः) 1 A sort of goblin. 2 Rising, growing, mounting. E. रुह to rise, aff. वुन्.
रोहग: रोहग m. (-गः) The name of a mountain, Adam's peak in Ceylon. E. रोह rising, and ग what goes.
रोहण: रोहण n. (-णं) 1 Semen virile. 2 Rising in or on, mounting, ascending. 3 Growing as a plant. 4 A mountain; see the last. E. रुह to grow, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
रोहन्त: रोहन्त m. (-न्तः) A kind of tree. f. (-न्ती) A sort of creeper. E. रुह to grow, Uṇādi aff. झच्, fem, aff. ङीष्.
रोहि: रोहि m. (-हिः) 1 A tree. 2 A seed. 3 A pious or religious man, one observing a vow, &c. E. रुह to grow, Uṇādi aff. इन्.
रोहिण: रोहिण m. (-णः) 1 The Indian fig tree. 2 A fragrant grass. n. (-णं) A part of the fore-noon, extending to mid-day, in which Śrāddhas are especially to be observed. E. रुह to grow, Uṇādi aff. इनच्.
रोहिणिका: रोहिणिका f. (-का) A woman red with anger, &c. or with red pigments. E. रोहिणी fem. form, of रोहित red, and कन् added.
रोहिणीपति: रोहिणीपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. रोहिणी the nymph, (see रोहिन्,) and पति husband.
रोहिणीवल्लभ: रोहिणीवल्लभ m. (-भः) The moon. E. रोहिणी the nymph, and वल्लभ the lover.
रोहिणीश: रोहिणीश m. (-शः) The moon. E. रोहिणी the nymph, and ईश lord or husband.
रोहित्: रोहित् m. (-हित्) The sun. f. (-हित्) 1 A deer, a doe. 2 A sort of creeper. E. रुह to go or grow, Uṇādi aff. इति.
रोहित: रोहित mfn. (रोहितः रोहिता or रोहिणी रोहितं) Red, of a red colour. m. (-तः) 1 Red, (the colour.) 2 The Rohi fish, (Cyprinus Rohita, HAM.) 3 A kind of deer. 4 A tree, (Andersonia Rohitaka, Rox.) n. (-तं) 1 INDRA'S bow unbent and invisible to mortals. 2 Safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.) 3 Blood. E. रुह to grow or go, Uṇādi aff. इतन्.
रोहितक: रोहितक m. (-कः) A tree, (Andersonia Rohitaka, Rox.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
रोहितश्व: रोहितश्व m. (-श्वः) 1 A name of AGNI. 2 The son of HARIŚCANDRA. E. रेहित् a deer, or red, and अश्व a horse; also from रोहित sometimes read रोहिताश्व.
रोहितिका: रोहितिका f. (-का) A woman whose face is stained with red pigments, or who is red with rage, &c. E. रोहित red, fem. form, कन् added.
रोहितेय: रोहितेय m. (-यः) A tree, (Andersonia Rohitaka.) E. रोहित the same, ढक् pleonastic aff.
रोहिन्: रोहिन् m. (-ही) 1 The Indian fig tree. 2 The holy fig tree. 3 The Andersonia Rohitaka. f. (-हिणिः-हिणी) 1 The fourth lunar asterism, figured by a wheeled carriage, and containing five stars, probably, α β γ δ ε Tauri; in mythology, the asterism is personified as one of the daughters of Dakṣa, and wives of the moon. 2 The mother of BALARĀMA. f. (-णी) 1 One of the Vidyādevīs of the Jainas. 2 A cow. 3 Inflammatory affection of the throat. 4 Lightning. 5 The name of a medicinal plant. 6 The moon plant, (Asclepias acida.) 7 A woman stained with red pigments, or red with passion, &c. 8 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) 9 Bengal madder. 10 A girl nine years old. E. रुह to grow, aff. णिनि.
रोहिष: रोहिष n. (-षं) A sort of grass. m. (-षः) 1 The Rohi, a kind of fish. 2 A deer said to resemble an ass.
रौक्ष्य: रौक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) 1 Roughness, ruggedness. 2 Harshness, unkindness. E. रुक्ष hard, व्यञ् aff.
रौचनिक: रौचनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Died or coloured with Rocana, of a yellowish or orange tint. n. (-कं) The tartar of the teeth. E. रोचना a pigment, and ठ् aff.
रौच्य: रौच्य m. (-च्यः) An ascetic with a staff of Bilva wood.
रौट: रौट(ऋ)रौटृ r. 1st cl. (रौटति) To treat with disrespect.
रौड: रौड(ऋ)रौडृ r. 1st cl. (रौडति) To treat with disrespect.
रौद्र: रौद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्री-द्रं) 1 Formidable, fearful, terrific. 2 Sharp, acute. 3 Relating or belonging to RUDRA or ŚIVA. 4 Violent, wrathful, irascible. mn. (-द्रः-द्रं) Wrath, rage, (the sentiment as an object of poetical description) m. (-द्रः) 1 Heat, warmth. 2 The cold season. 3 YAMA. f. (-द्री) GAURI, the wife of ŚIVA. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, &c., and अण् aff.
रौद्रता: रौद्रता f. (-ता) Fierceness, formidableness. E. रौद्र, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रौद्रत्वं.
रौद्रदर्शन: रौद्रदर्शन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Formidable, terrific. E. रौद्र, and दर्शन appearance.
रौप्य: रौप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्यी-प्यं) Silver, of silver. n. (-प्यं) Silver. E. रूप्य the same, अण् pleonasm or aff. of relation.
रौम: रौम n. (-मं) A sort of salt; see the next. E. रुम the place where it is found, अण् aff.
रौमक: रौमक n. (-कं) A kind of salt, according to some authorities, brought from a mountain in Ajmere, but in fact procured from a salt lake near the town of Sāmbher, about twenty miles west of Jayanagar. E. रुम the district of Ruma or Sāmbher, aff. अण्, and कन् added; also रौम, and रौमलवण.
रौमलवण: रौमलवण n. (-णं) Sāmbher salt; see the last. E. रौम as above, and लवण salt.
रौरव: रौरव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) 1 Formidable, horrible, terrific. 2 Dishonest, fraudulent. 3 Unsteady, slipping. m. (-वः) 1 One of the divisions of Naraka or Tartarus. 2 A savage, a monster. E. रुद to weep, deriv. irr., or रुरु said to mean a living being, अण् aff.
रौहिणेय: रौहिणेय m. (-यः) 1 A name of BALARĀMA. 2 The planet MERCURY. n. (-यं) An emerald. mf. (-यः-यी) A calf. E. रोहिणी the nymph, &c., and ढक् aff.
रौहिष: रौहिष m. (-षः) 1 A sort of deer. 2 The Rohi fish. n. (-षं) A kind of grass. E. रुह to grow, Uṇādi aff. ठिषच्, and the vowel changed to औ. ल
